name: Gastro-Oncology
content:
At ILS Hospital Raipur, our Gastro-Oncology department provides comprehensive, advanced, and compassionate care for cancers affecting the digestive system. With a team of experienced gastroenterologists, oncologists, surgeons, and support specialists, we deliver accurate diagnosis and personalized treatment plans focused on long-term outcomes and quality of life.

We Offer Advanced Treatment for:

  • Esophageal Cancer
  • Stomach (Gastric) Cancer
  • Pancreatic Cancer
  • Liver Cancer
  • Colonic & Colorectal Cancer
  • Gallbladder Cancer

Our treatment approach combines advanced endoscopy, minimally invasive and laparoscopic surgery, chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and supportive care, ensuring comprehensive management under one roof.

Never Ignore the Symptoms

Early detection plays a critical role in successful cancer treatment. Consult our specialists if you experience persistent or worsening symptoms such as:

  1. Digestive Symptoms
    • Persistent abdominal pain or discomfort
    • Bloating or feeling full after small meals
    • Chronic indigestion or heartburn
    • Nausea or vomiting, sometimes with blood
  2. Changes in Bowel Habits
    • Persistent diarrhea or constipation
    • Narrow or ribbon-like stools
    • Blood in stool (bright red, maroon, or black stools)
    • Feeling of incomplete bowel evacuation
  3. Weight & Appetite Changes
    • Unexplained weight loss
    • Loss of appetite
    • Early satiety
  4. General Symptoms
    • Ongoing fatigue or weakness
    • Unexplained anemia (low hemoglobin levels)

Why Choose ILS Hospital Raipur?

  • Experienced gastro-oncology specialists
  • Advanced diagnostics and evidence-based treatments
  • Multidisciplinary cancer care team
  • Patient-centric approach with continuous follow-up

Timely consultation can save lives. If you or your loved one notice any concerning symptoms, connect with our Gastro-Oncology experts at ILS Hospital Raipur for early diagnosis and comprehensive cancer care.

name: Uro-Onco
content:
Urology is the medical specialty that deals with the diagnosis and treatment of diseases related to the kidneys, ureters, urinary bladder, prostate, urethra, and male reproductive organs. Kidney-, urinary tract– and prostate-related disorders are treated under the urology department. Many of these diseases can be treated effectively with modern, minimally invasive procedures.

Common Symptoms of Urological Problems:

  • Blood in urine
  • Frequent or painful urination
  • Lower abdominal or back pain
  • Difficulty in urination
  • Recurrent urinary infection
  • Urological diseases can affect anyone, including children and adults.

Causes of Urological Diseases:

  • Recurrent urine infections
  • Kidney stones
  • Prostate enlargement
  • Cancer of kidney, bladder or prostate

name: Neurology Raipur
content:
The Department of Neurology & Interventional Neurology at ILS Hospitals is dedicated to providing round-the-clock diagnostic and therapeutic neurology services based on evidence-backed protocols aligned with internationally accepted guidelines. Our 24/7 casualty services cater to the diagnosis and early management of neurological emergencies, including Status Epilepticus, Stroke, Neuromuscular Weakness, Encephalitis, Meningitis, and behaviour changes.

Specialized Departments:

Department of Neurology & Stroke:

  • Equipped with ICU facilities and bedside Electro Encephalogram (EEG) Monitoring.
  • Round-the-clock neurologists for diagnosis, treatment, and management.
  • State-of-the-art diagnostic imaging modalities, including MRI and CT Scan.

Services:

  • Comprehensive stroke care, including IV Thrombolysis and mechanical thrombectomy.
  • Diagnosis and management of Seizure Disorders and Refractory Epilepsies.
  • Neurophysiology unit offering EEG, EMG and NCV.
  • Management of Neuromuscular Disorders, Peripheral Neuropathies, Headaches, and Chronic Pains.
  • Neuro Rehabilitation, including Physiotherapy and Occupational Therapy.

Department of Interventional Neurology:

  • Minimally invasive solutions for complex brain diseases.
  • Specialists skilled in delicate and high-precision procedures.
  • Intra-arterial/intravenous route interventions for minimal trauma and fast recovery.
  • Focus on Comprehensive Stroke Management & Treatment.

Rehabilitation Services and Behavioural Sciences:

  • Committed to providing comprehensive rehabilitation services.
  • Integration of behavioural sciences for holistic patient care.

Why Choose ILS Hospitals’ Institute of Neurosciences?

  • Round-the-Clock Care: Our dedicated team ensures 24/7 care for neurology emergencies.
  • Advanced Technology: State-of-the-art diagnostic and infrastructure for precise interventions.
  • Comprehensive Services: From diagnostics to rehabilitation, we offer a continuum of neurological care.
  • Expert Specialists: Experienced neurologists and interventionists lead our team.

At ILS Hospitals, we are committed to delivering international-class, patient-centric neurological care. Our foundation rests on ethics and morality, ensuring that every patient receives the highest standard of care. Trust us for your neurological well-being.

name: Minimally Invasive Gynecologic Surgery
heading: Minimally Invasive Gynaecologic Surgery at ILS Hospitals
content:
Minimally Invasive Gynaecologic Surgery at ILS Hospitals

At ILS Hospital Saltlake, we deliver advanced patient-centric women’s health care through the latest innovations. A major leap in the treatment of complex gynaecological conditions is represented by Minimally Invasive Gynaecological Surgery (MIGS). MIGS is faster, safer, and more precise than traditional surgery. Using procedures such as laparoscopy, hysteroscopy, and advanced endoscopy, our gynaecology team performs various surgeries through small incisions, ensuring minimal discomfort and a quick recovery.

At ILS Saltlake, MIGS is supported by state-of-the-art technology, modern OTs and highly trained gynaecologic surgeons, who specialise in advanced laparoscopic and hysteroscopic interventions. This approach enhances surgical outcomes and improves the overall experience for women seeking timely, compassionate care.

Why It Is Needed

Many women suffer in silence from gynaecological conditions like uterine fibroids, ovarian cysts, endometriosis, abnormal bleeding, pelvic pain, uterine prolapse, and fertility-related disorders. These conditions impact quality of life and create discomfort. Traditional surgery requires large incisions, a long hospital stay, and a long recovery.

But minimally invasive surgery offers:

  • Less pain and scarring
  • Reduced blood loss
  • Lower risk of infection
  • Shorter hospital stay
  • Faster return to daily activities

MIGS is the best option for women who cannot afford extended downtime because of work or family obligations. Our specialists at ILS Hospital Saltlake assess each patient’s condition and suggest the least invasive, safest, and most suitable surgical course.

Preparation

Before undergoing MIGS, patients undergo a thorough evaluation at ILS Hospitals, which includes:

  • Pelvic examination
  • Ultrasound or MRI scans
  • Blood tests and hormonal assessments
  • Medical history review
  • Anesthesia evaluation

Our team ensures the patient is fully aware of the procedures, the anticipated recovery course, and any safety measures. In order to lower anxiety and guarantee comfort and confidence prior to the procedure, counselling is also offered.

Procedure Details

heading: Gastrointestinal (GI) Surgery at ILS Hospitals
content:
Gastrointestinal (GI) Surgery at ILS Hospitals

Gastrointestinal (GI) surgery is a specialised field focused on treating conditions affecting the digestive system—including the stomach, intestines, liver, pancreas, and gallbladder. At ILS Hospitals, we offer comprehensive GI surgical care, combining advanced medical technology with surgical expertise to deliver safe, effective, and patient-centred outcomes.

Our experienced team of GI surgeons is trained to perform both routine and complex procedures, ensuring each patient receives the most appropriate and minimally invasive treatment whenever possible. Minimally invasive techniques help reduce pain, shorten hospital stays, and promote faster recovery.

We specialise in:

  • Laparoscopic cholecystectomy (gallbladder stone removal)
  • Laparoscopic appendectomy
  • Hernia repair (inguinal, umbilical, incisional, etc.)
  • Colorectal surgeries, including cancer resection
  • Surgeries for gastrointestinal cancers
  • Anti-reflux surgery (for GERD)
  • Pancreatic and liver surgeries
  • Management of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD)

At ILS Hospitals, we follow a multidisciplinary approach, where GI surgeons work closely with gastroenterologists, oncologists, radiologists, anesthesiologists, and dietitians. This collaboration ensures a seamless care experience from diagnosis to recovery.

Our hospitals are equipped with state-of-the-art diagnostic and surgical tools, including:

  • Endoscopy and colonoscopy
  • ERCP (Endoscopic Retrograde Cholangiopancreatography)
  • MRCP (Magnetic Resonance Cholangiopancreatography)
  • EUS (Endoscopic Ultrasound)

We emphasise clear communication, detailed pre-surgical evaluations, and personalised care plans. Every surgical case is thoroughly assessed to ensure safety, comfort, and the best possible outcomes. Post-operative care is equally important, with our team providing rehabilitation support and continuous follow-up to aid recovery.

What truly sets ILS Hospitals apart is our commitment to compassionate care and clinical excellence. Our team understands the anxiety that often surrounds surgery and strives to provide reassurance through empathy, transparency, and patient education.

Whether you’re seeking relief from chronic digestive discomfort or require complex surgical intervention, ILS Hospitals is equipped to provide high-quality GI care tailored to your needs.

name: Radiology (Interventional)
heading: Radiology (Interventional)
content:
Radiology (Interventional)

Interventional Radiology (IR) is a cutting-edge medical specialty that uses advanced imaging technologies to perform minimally invasive, targeted treatments. At ILS Hospitals, the Interventional Radiology department plays a crucial role in diagnosing and treating a wide range of conditions without the need for traditional open surgery. By combining precision imaging with expert procedural skills, the department offers patients safer, less painful alternatives with faster recovery times.

What is Interventional Radiology?

Interventional Radiology involves the use of imaging tools—such as X-ray fluoroscopy, ultrasound, CT scans, and MRI—to guide fine instruments like catheters, needles, and wires directly to the affected area. These procedures are often performed under local anesthesia or mild sedation, minimizing patient discomfort and reducing hospital stay duration.

Scope of Services at ILS Hospitals

The Interventional Radiology team at ILS Hospitals offers a comprehensive range of procedures across multiple specialties, including:

  • Vascular Interventions: Angioplasty, stenting, thrombolysis, and embolization for treating blocked or abnormal blood vessels.
  • Oncology Interventions: Image-guided tumor ablation, chemoembolization, and radiofrequency ablation for precise cancer treatment.
  • Biliary and Gastrointestinal Interventions: Biliary drainage, stent placements, and management of gastrointestinal obstructions.
  • Renal and Urological Interventions: Nephrostomy, ureteral stenting, and varicocele embolization.
  • Neurological Interventions: Endovascular treatment for aneurysms, arteriovenous malformations (AVMs), and acute stroke therapy.
  • Biopsies and Drainages: Image-guided tissue biopsies and fluid drainage from abscesses or cysts.

Expert Team and Multidisciplinary Collaboration

The Interventional Radiology department at ILS Hospitals is led by experienced interventional radiologists trained in both diagnostic imaging and advanced therapeutic procedures. They work in close collaboration with specialists from cardiology, neurology, oncology, gastroenterology, nephrology, and surgery to create personalized treatment plans. This multidisciplinary approach ensures the safest, most effective outcomes for patients.

Advanced Technology and Facilities

ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art imaging suites and catheterization labs designed specifically for interventional procedures. High-resolution fluoroscopy units, advanced ultrasound systems, and CT/MRI guidance enable real-time visualization, ensuring precise targeting and minimal damage to surrounding tissues.

Benefits of Interventional Radiology

Compared to traditional surgery, IR offers numerous advantages, including:

  • Smaller incisions and minimal scarring
  • Reduced risk of complications
  • Shorter hospital stays
  • Quicker return to normal activities
  • Often performed under local anesthesia, reducing anesthesia-related risks

Emergency and Critical Care Support

The department operates 24/7 for emergencies such as active bleeding, acute stroke, deep vein thrombosis, and traumatic vascular injuries. Immediate access to interventional radiology can be life-saving in such situations.

Patient-Centric Approach

At ILS Hospitals, patient comfort and safety are top priorities. The IR team explains each procedure in detail, addresses concerns, and provides post-procedure care instructions to ensure smooth recovery. Continuous follow-up and monitoring are part of the treatment process, especially for chronic or complex conditions.

Interventional Radiology at ILS Hospitals represents the perfect blend of advanced imaging, minimally invasive techniques, and specialized expertise. By offering precise, targeted treatments with fewer risks and faster recoveries, the department is transforming patient care across multiple specialties. Whether it’s managing life-threatening emergencies, treating complex diseases, or performing delicate image-guided interventions, ILS Hospitals’ Interventional Radiology team stands at the forefront of innovative and compassionate healthcare.

mainEntity.name: How to book an appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Book an appointment online at www.ilshospitals.com or mail your queries to info@ilshospitals.com or call us at: Agartala: 8974050300, 0381 241 5000 Dumdum: 033 4031 5000 Howrah: 033 4088 0000, 033 4088 1202 Salt Lake: 033 4020 6500

mainEntity.name: What are the visiting hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visiting hours are as followed: Ward/Twin Sharing/Cabin/Suite: 9am - 10am | 5pm - 7pm ITU/ICU/CCU/NICU/HDU: 5pm - 6pm | 9am - 10am (Saltlake only)

mainEntity.name: Rules and guidelines for visitors

acceptedAnswer.text: Visitors must carry visitor pass. Only two persons are allowed during visiting hours at Ward/Twin Sharing/Cabin/Suite and only one person is allowed during visiting hours at ITU/ICU/CCU/NICU/HDU. Children are strictly not allowed in critical care areas.

mainEntity.name: Is outside food allowed into the hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outside medicines and foods are not allowed within hospital premises. Patient meals are served as per instruction of the doctor and dietician.

mainEntity.name: What is the mode of payment in your hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: The payment can be made by Cash / Credit Card / Debit Cards/ DD/ Wire Transfer / Cheque.

mainEntity.name: Is advance payment must for an emergency case?

acceptedAnswer.text: During emergency every minute is vital so the admission is done immediately without any advance deposit money and the patient is taken under medical observation.

mainEntity.name: Do you have any health check up packages?

acceptedAnswer.text: ILS Hospitals are equipped with the latest and accurate testing equipments, trained technicians and specialists providing an advance range of health check up and screening services. This Health Check up Packages covers a wide range of investigations like from basic standard set of blood tests to detailed physical examinations and consultation by experienced doctors and each package is tailored to suit the needs of an individual.

mainEntity.name: Do you have the facility of cashless treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Cashless facility is available for empanelled TPA's & insurance Companies.

mainEntity.name: Is Mediclaim policy accepted at your hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, empanelled TPA's & insurance Companies are accepted at the hospitals.

mainEntity.name: Does the hospital have 24×7 emergency care services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, 24 x 7 Emergency care service is available at the hospitals.

mainEntity.name: Is Dialysis facility available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Dialysis facility is available at ILS Hospitals Agartala and ILS Hospitals Dumdum.

mainEntity.name: How the bed charges are calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bed charges are calculated as per 24 hour basis from the time of admission.

mainEntity.name: Working hours of Admission and Billing section?

acceptedAnswer.text: Admission and Billing section functions 24x7.

mainEntity.name: What are the required documents for admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: The mainly required documents are Prescription of any previous treatment, Diagnostic test reports, Details of all medicine & dosages of the patient, Patient id proof, insurance or medical benefit card or proof.

name: Radiology
heading: Radiology
content:
Radiology

Radiology is a cornerstone of modern medical diagnostics, enabling accurate visualization of the body’s internal structures to aid in the detection, diagnosis, and monitoring of diseases. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Radiology plays a pivotal role in patient care by providing high-quality imaging services supported by advanced technology, skilled radiologists, and a commitment to precision.

Scope of the Radiology Department

The Radiology department at ILS Hospitals offers a comprehensive range of imaging services, including X-rays, ultrasound, Doppler studies, mammography, computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), digital fluoroscopy, and interventional radiology procedures. These services are essential for evaluating conditions affecting the brain, heart, lungs, abdomen, musculoskeletal system, and more.

Expert Radiology Team

The department is staffed by experienced radiologists, radiographers, and imaging technologists who ensure accurate interpretation of images and smooth patient experiences. Radiologists work closely with referring physicians and specialists to correlate imaging findings with clinical conditions, enabling prompt and effective treatment planning.

Advanced Technology and Imaging Facilities

ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art imaging systems that deliver high-resolution images while minimizing patient exposure to radiation. The use of digital imaging systems ensures faster processing, easier storage, and immediate sharing of images with other departments for multidisciplinary consultations.

  •  X-Ray & Digital Radiography: Fast and efficient for bone fractures, chest evaluations, and initial screenings.
  • Ultrasound & Doppler: Safe, non-invasive imaging for abdominal, obstetric, and vascular assessments.
  • CT Scans: Detailed cross-sectional imaging for trauma evaluation, cancer detection, and complex anatomical studies.
  • MRI: High-resolution imaging for brain, spine, joints, and soft tissues without ionizing radiation.
  • Mammography: Specialized imaging for early detection of breast cancer.

Interventional Radiology

In addition to diagnostic imaging, the department offers interventional radiology services—minimally invasive, image-guided procedures such as biopsies, catheter placements, angiography, and drainage procedures. These interventions often reduce the need for open surgery, resulting in shorter recovery times and less discomfort for patients.

24/7 Imaging Support

The Radiology department operates round-the-clock to provide urgent imaging support for emergency cases, critical care patients, and surgical procedures. Rapid imaging and reporting are crucial in trauma, stroke, and acute medical conditions, where timely diagnosis can save lives.

Patient Safety and Comfort

ILS Hospitals prioritizes patient safety through strict radiation safety protocols, regular equipment calibration, and the use of protective measures. Technologists are trained to ensure patient comfort during procedures, with special care given to children, elderly patients, and those with mobility limitations.

Collaborative Care Approach

Radiologists at ILS Hospitals work in close coordination with specialists from cardiology, neurology, orthopaedics, oncology, and other fields to provide comprehensive, multidisciplinary care. Detailed radiology reports, supported by advanced imaging, help clinicians make informed decisions for treatment.

The Department of Radiology at ILS Hospitals is more than just a diagnostic unit—it is a vital partner in delivering accurate, timely, and safe medical care. With cutting-edge imaging technology, skilled professionals, and a patient-first approach, the department ensures that every scan and procedure contributes to better diagnosis, treatment, and overall health outcomes. Whether for routine screenings, complex diagnoses, or life-saving interventions, ILS Hospitals’ Radiology team stands ready to provide excellence in imaging services.

name: Microbiology
heading: Microbiology
content:
Microbiology

Microbiology is a vital branch of medical science that deals with the study of microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, fungi, and parasites, and their role in human health and disease. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Microbiology plays a critical role in the diagnosis, prevention, and management of infectious diseases. By combining advanced laboratory technology, expert analysis, and stringent quality standards, the department ensures timely and accurate results that form the backbone of effective patient care.

Scope of the Microbiology Department

The department handles a wide spectrum of diagnostic services, including bacterial culture and sensitivity testing, viral detection, fungal identification, and parasitology. It plays a crucial role in diagnosing infections such as tuberculosis, sepsis, respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, gastrointestinal diseases, and hospital-acquired infections. Specialized tests for antibiotic resistance, such as MRSA and ESBL detection, help guide targeted and effective treatment strategies.

Expert Team and Advanced Facilities

At ILS Hospitals, the Microbiology department is staffed by experienced microbiologists, laboratory technicians, and infection control specialists. The team follows internationally recognized protocols and maintains strict adherence to biosafety measures. Equipped with automated culture systems, real-time PCR machines, ELISA analyzers, and advanced microscopy, the department ensures high accuracy, quick turnaround times, and reliable reporting for clinicians.

Infection Control and Hospital Safety

One of the key roles of the Microbiology department is infection prevention and control within the hospital. The team works closely with the Infection Control Committee to monitor hospital hygiene, sterilization procedures, and antimicrobial stewardship programs. Regular surveillance of hospital environments helps in early detection and control of potential outbreaks, safeguarding both patients and healthcare staff.

Support for Clinicians

Microbiology services at ILS Hospitals are deeply integrated into the hospital’s clinical care system. The department works in close collaboration with physicians, surgeons, and specialists to interpret lab findings and recommend appropriate antimicrobial therapy. This partnership ensures that patients receive the most effective treatment while minimizing unnecessary or inappropriate use of antibiotics.

Specialized Testing for Public Health

In addition to routine diagnostics, the department conducts specialized tests during outbreaks and public health emergencies. Whether it’s rapid detection of seasonal flu viruses, COVID-19, or foodborne pathogens, the Microbiology team provides critical data that guides timely interventions and community health measures.

Quality Assurance and Accreditation

To maintain the highest standards, the department participates in internal and external quality control programs. Regular staff training and strict adherence to accreditation guidelines ensure that laboratory processes are both accurate and ethically conducted.

Research and Continuous Development

The Microbiology department also contributes to ongoing research and innovation, studying emerging pathogens and resistance patterns. This helps in shaping treatment guidelines, developing new diagnostic approaches, and strengthening the hospital’s ability to respond to evolving infectious threats.

The Department of Microbiology at ILS Hospitals is much more than a diagnostic unit—it is a cornerstone of patient safety, clinical excellence, and public health protection. Through advanced technology, expert knowledge, and a commitment to precision, the department ensures that infections are detected early, treated effectively, and prevented whenever possible. In doing so, it plays an indispensable role in safeguarding the health of patients and the community.

name: Pathology
heading: Pathology
content:
Pathology

Pathology is the cornerstone of modern medicine, providing critical insights into the nature, cause, and progression of diseases. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Pathology plays a vital role in patient care by delivering accurate, timely, and reliable diagnostic services that guide treatment decisions and improve outcomes. By combining advanced technology, expert analysis, and stringent quality control measures, the department ensures the highest standard of laboratory services for both inpatients and outpatients.

Scope of the Pathology Department

The Pathology department at ILS Hospitals covers all major areas of diagnostic pathology, including histopathology, cytology, hematology, clinical biochemistry, microbiology, and immunology. It handles a wide range of diagnostic tests, from routine blood work and urine analysis to complex tissue biopsies and tumor marker studies. These tests are essential for detecting infections, autoimmune conditions, metabolic disorders, cancers, and other medical conditions at various stages.

Expert Team of Specialists

The department is staffed by highly qualified pathologists, laboratory technicians, and support staff who bring years of expertise and meticulous attention to detail. The pathologists work closely with clinicians from various specialties to interpret results, suggest further investigations, and support accurate diagnosis. This collaborative approach ensures that patients receive the most appropriate and effective treatment plans.

Advanced Laboratory Technology

ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art laboratory instruments that enhance both the speed and accuracy of diagnostics. Fully automated analyzers, digital pathology systems, and advanced imaging tools enable rapid processing of samples while minimizing errors. The laboratories are designed with separate sections for different disciplines, ensuring safety, efficiency, and compliance with international standards.

Histopathology and Cytology Services

Histopathology involves the microscopic examination of tissue samples to detect abnormalities such as cancer, inflammatory diseases, and degenerative disorders. Cytology services, including Pap smears and fine needle aspiration cytology (FNAC), play a crucial role in early detection of cancers and other cellular changes. At ILS Hospitals, these services are performed with precision, ensuring early intervention and improved patient outcomes.

Hematology and Clinical Biochemistry

Hematology services include the study of blood disorders, such as anemia, clotting abnormalities, and leukemia, while clinical biochemistry covers tests related to kidney function, liver enzymes, hormones, and metabolic profiles. These tests are essential for both diagnosis and monitoring of ongoing treatments.

Stringent Quality Control

The Pathology department adheres to strict internal and external quality control protocols to maintain accuracy and reliability. Regular calibration of instruments, participation in proficiency testing programs, and continuous staff training ensure that results meet the highest standards of excellence.

Support for Preventive Healthcare

In addition to disease diagnosis, the department plays a key role in preventive health by offering wellness packages, cancer screenings, and routine health check-ups. Early detection through these services helps prevent the progression of many illnesses.

The Department of Pathology at ILS Hospitals is more than just a laboratory—it is an essential partner in patient care. By providing precise diagnostic information, supporting clinical decisions, and contributing to preventive healthcare, the department ensures that patients receive timely and effective treatment. With advanced facilities, expert professionals, and a commitment to excellence, ILS Hospitals’ Pathology department stands as a pillar of trust and accuracy in healthcare.

mainEntity.name: How the bed charges are calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Admission and Billing section functions 24x7.

name: General Robotic Surgery
heading: Robotic Surgery (General Surgery)
content:
Robotic Surgery (General Surgery)

Robotic surgery has transformed the landscape of general surgery, offering a highly advanced, minimally invasive approach to treating various conditions. This cutting-edge technology combines precision, control, and visualization to enable surgeons to perform complex procedures with improved accuracy and outcomes. As a result, robotic surgery has become a preferred option for patients and surgeons alike, particularly in general surgical procedures that demand meticulous execution.

At its core, robotic surgery involves the use of robotic systems equipped with advanced features like high-definition 3D imaging and robotic arms. These arms are controlled by the surgeon and replicate human hand movements with exceptional precision, allowing for enhanced dexterity and access to hard-to-reach areas. Robotic-assisted general surgeries include procedures such as hernia repair, gallbladder removal, colorectal surgeries, bariatric surgeries, and gastrointestinal surgeries.

One of the key advantages of robotic surgery is its minimally invasive nature. This approach requires smaller incisions compared to traditional open surgeries, leading to less tissue damage and scarring. Patients undergoing robotic surgery often experience reduced postoperative pain, minimal blood loss, and a lower risk of infections. These benefits contribute to faster recovery times, shorter hospital stays, and a quicker return to daily activities.

In addition to patient-centric advantages, robotic surgery offers surgeons unparalleled control and clarity. The robotic system’s high-definition, magnified 3D imaging allows for a detailed view of the surgical site, ensuring precise movements and reducing the likelihood of complications. This is particularly important in procedures involving delicate tissues and vital structures, where precision is critical for optimal outcomes.

Another significant benefit of robotic surgery is the consistency it provides. The technology eliminates variability in techniques, ensuring uniformity in surgical performance. This not only improves immediate results but also enhances long-term success rates, making robotic-assisted procedures a reliable choice for patients with complex conditions.

Robotic surgery reflects the future of general surgery, blending advanced technology with the expertise of skilled surgeons to improve outcomes and patient experiences. It represents a shift towards safer, more efficient, and less invasive treatment options that prioritize patient well-being.

As robotic technology continues to evolve, its application in general surgery is expected to expand further, setting new benchmarks in precision and care. Robotic surgery is not just a technological advancement—it’s a step toward redefining the standard of surgical excellence worldwide.

Why Choose ILS Hospitals for General Robotic Surgery?

At ILS Hospitals, we combine state-of-the-art robotic technology with the expertise of our highly trained surgeons to deliver unparalleled care. Our advanced facilities ensure precision-driven procedures tailored to meet individual patient needs, resulting in superior outcomes and a better quality of life.

With a commitment to excellence, patient safety, and personalized care, ILS Hospitals sets the benchmark in robotic surgery. When you choose us, you choose innovation, reliability, and a faster road to recovery.

Experience the future of surgery with ILS Hospitals—where technology meets compassionate care.

name: Robotic Surgery (Gynecology)
heading: Robotic Surgery in Gynecology
content:
Robotic Surgery in Gynecology

Gynaecological surgeries often involve intricate procedures where precision, minimal invasiveness, and faster recovery play a critical role in improving patient outcomes. At ILS Hospitals, we offer robotic-assisted surgery as a revolutionary approach to managing complex gynaecological conditions, ensuring better results with enhanced patient comfort and quicker recovery times.

Robotic surgery employs advanced technology, including high-definition 3D imaging and robotic arms that replicate a surgeon’s hand movements with exceptional accuracy. This cutting-edge system allows our surgeons to access hard-to-reach areas with precision, making it ideal for procedures such as fibroid removal, hysterectomy, ovarian cystectomy, treatment for endometriosis, pelvic organ prolapse repair, and early-stage gynaecological cancer surgeries.

One of the primary benefits of robotic surgery is its minimally invasive nature. The procedure is performed through smaller incisions, resulting in less tissue damage, minimal scarring, reduced blood loss, and a lower risk of infection. This not only ensures faster recovery but also minimizes postoperative discomfort, allowing patients to return to their normal lives much sooner than with traditional open surgery.

The robotic system provides surgeons with superior visualization and magnification, enabling them to identify and address abnormalities with unmatched clarity. For example, in myomectomy and hysterectomy procedures, robotic surgery ensures precise removal of fibroids or the uterus while preserving healthy tissues and improving reproductive outcomes. Similarly, in gynaecological cancer surgeries, robotic technology enables accurate removal of cancerous tissues, improving survival rates and reducing recurrence risks.

At ILS Hospitals, our highly skilled gynaecological team is trained in advanced robotic-assisted techniques. We prioritize patient safety and satisfaction by combining the latest technology with compassionate, personalized care. Robotic surgery ensures consistent results, reduces postoperative complications, and provides a higher standard of care for women facing various gynaecological conditions.

Whether it’s a routine procedure or a complex surgery, robotic-assisted surgery at ILS Hospitals redefines the boundaries of precision and care. Our commitment to innovation and excellence makes us a trusted choice for women seeking world-class treatment.

Experience the future of gynaecological care at ILS Hospitals, where technology meets expertise to empower women with better health and improved quality of life.

Why Choose ILS Hospitals for Robotic Surgery?

At ILS Hospitals, we combine world-class technology with a compassionate approach to patient care. Our team of expert surgeons is highly trained in robotic-assisted procedures, ensuring precision and safety during every surgery. Additionally, we provide a comprehensive range of post-operative care, ensuring that recovery is as smooth and efficient as possible.

name: Robotic Surgery (Orthopaedics)
heading: Robotic Surgery in Orthopaedics
content:
Robotic Surgery in Orthopaedics

Orthopaedic surgeries often involve complex procedures such as joint replacements, spine surgeries, and intricate fracture repairs, where precision is critical to ensure optimal outcomes. Traditional methods, while effective, can have limitations in accuracy and recovery time. Robotic surgery has emerged as a game-changing advancement in orthopaedics, providing surgeons with cutting-edge tools that enhance their ability to perform precise and efficient procedures.

At the heart of robotic-assisted surgery lies advanced technology, such as real-time 3D imaging and enhanced visual clarity. These tools allow surgeons to map a patient’s anatomy with unparalleled detail, ensuring personalized and accurate interventions. At ILS Hospitals, robotic-assisted systems are extensively used for joint replacement surgeries, particularly for the hip, knee, and shoulder. This innovative approach ensures that the prosthetic components are placed with exact alignment, which is crucial for long-term functionality and durability.

The benefits of robotic surgery in orthopaedics are multifaceted. One of the most significant advantages is enhanced precision, which not only improves surgical outcomes but also reduces the risk of complications. Patients undergoing robotic surgery typically experience smaller incisions, which means less tissue damage, minimal scarring, and faster wound healing. Additionally, the minimally invasive nature of the procedure results in reduced postoperative pain and lower blood loss, making recovery smoother and more comfortable.

Another noteworthy benefit is the shorter recovery time associated with robotic surgery. Patients often spend less time in the hospital and can return to their normal activities much sooner compared to traditional surgical methods. This is particularly important for joint replacement surgeries, where early mobilization is crucial for long-term success.

Robotic surgery also supports surgeons in achieving greater consistency and accuracy during procedures. By eliminating the variability often associated with manual techniques, it ensures that each step of the surgery is performed with precision. This not only improves immediate outcomes but also enhances the longevity of joint replacements, reducing the need for revision surgeries.

Why Choose ILS Hospitals for Robotic Surgery?

At ILS Hospitals, we combine world-class technology with a compassionate approach to patient care. Our team of expert surgeons is highly trained in robotic-assisted procedures, ensuring precision and safety during every surgery. Additionally, we provide a comprehensive range of post-operative care, ensuring that recovery is as smooth and efficient as possible.

name: Radiation Therapy
heading: Radiation Therapy at ILS Hospitals
content:
Radiation Therapy at ILS Hospitals

Radiation therapy is a medical treatment that uses high-energy radiation to destroy or damage cancer cells. It can be used to treat a wide range of cancers, including those of the breast, lung, prostate, and brain. The radiation works by disrupting the DNA within cancer cells, preventing them from growing and dividing. Over time, these damaged cells are eliminated from the body.

Types of Radiation Therapy Offered at ILS Hospital

At ILS Hospital, we provide different types of radiation therapy, depending on the nature and location of the cancer. These include:

  • External Beam Radiation Therapy (EBRT): This is the most common form of radiation therapy where a machine directs high-energy beams of radiation at the cancer from outside the body. The treatment is non-invasive and is typically given over several sessions.
  • Brachytherapy: This involves placing radioactive sources inside or near the tumor. Brachytherapy is particularly effective for cancers in areas like the prostate, cervix, and breast.
  • Stereotactic Radiosurgery (SRS): For tumors located in the brain or spine, SRS provides high-precision radiation beams that target the tumor with minimal impact on surrounding healthy tissue.
  • Intensity-Modulated Radiation Therapy (IMRT): IMRT is an advanced form of EBRT that uses computer-generated images to precisely target the tumor while minimizing exposure to healthy tissue.

Why Choose ILS Hospital for Radiation Cancer Treatment?

  • Expert Oncologists and Radiation Therapists: ILS Hospital has a team of highly qualified oncologists, radiation oncologists, and therapists who specialize in providing personalized care for cancer patients. They work collaboratively to design an individualized treatment plan that suits each patient’s specific needs.
  • Advanced Technology: We use the latest in radiation therapy technology to ensure precision and effectiveness in treating cancer, minimizing side effects and improving recovery outcomes.
  • Comprehensive Support: We offer psychological support, nutritional counseling, and rehabilitation services to help patients manage the physical and emotional challenges during treatment.

At ILS Hospital, we are committed to offering the best in cancer care. Through expert care, advanced technology, and compassionate support, we strive to help patients on their journey to recovery and a better quality of life.

name: Oncology
heading: Oncology at ILS Hospitals
content:
Oncology at ILS Hospitals

Oncology is the branch of medicine focused on the diagnosis, treatment, and management of cancer. The field of oncology encompasses various sub-specialties, including medical oncology, surgical oncology, radiation oncology, and pediatric oncology. At ILS Hospital, our multidisciplinary oncology team collaborates to design customized treatment plans for every patient, ensuring the best possible outcomes.

Types of Cancer Treatment at ILS Hospital

  • Medical Oncology: Medical oncology involves the use of chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and hormone therapy to treat cancer. Our experienced medical oncologists specialize in selecting the most appropriate treatment options based on the type of cancer and the patient’s overall health. We offer access to the latest drug therapies and clinical trials, ensuring patients receive cutting-edge treatment.
  • Surgical Oncology: Surgical oncology plays a key role in cancer treatment. It involves the removal of tumors or cancerous tissues to prevent the spread of cancer. Our highly skilled surgical oncologists perform a wide range of procedures, from tumor excision to lymph node removal, using minimally invasive techniques to ensure faster recovery and less discomfort.
  • Radiation Oncology: Radiation therapy uses high-energy radiation to target and destroy cancer cells. At ILS Hospital, we offer advanced radiation therapies like External Beam Radiation Therapy (EBRT), Brachytherapy, and Stereotactic Radiosurgery (SRS). These treatments are precisely tailored to each patient, minimizing damage to surrounding healthy tissues.
  • Palliative Care and Supportive Services: We believe that the well-being of the patient extends beyond just treating the cancer. Our oncology team offers comprehensive palliative care to help manage symptoms and improve quality of life. This includes pain management, nutritional counseling, psychological support, and rehabilitation services, ensuring that patients are supported throughout their treatment process.

PET CT Scan: Advanced Imaging for Precision Diagnosis

Perfusion Computed Tomography (PET) CT scan is a cutting-edge imaging technique used to assess blood flow in tissues, especially the brain. It helps in detecting conditions like strokes, tumors, and blood circulation issues. This non-invasive scan delivers real-time, detailed images, enabling doctors to evaluate tissue health and plan accurate treatments.

PET CT scans are vital in emergency situations, providing rapid and reliable results for quick medical intervention. They are especially beneficial in stroke diagnosis, helping identify the affected areas and guiding targeted therapies. With advanced technology and skilled radiologists, PET CT scans ensure accurate diagnostics and better patient outcomes.

Why Choose ILS Hospital for Cancer Treatment?

  • Expert Oncology Team: Our team includes leading oncologists, surgeons, radiologists, and support staff who work collaboratively to provide personalized treatment plans. Their expertise in treating a wide variety of cancers ensures that patients receive the most advanced and effective therapies available.
  • State-of-the-Art Technology: ILS Hospital is equipped with the latest in diagnostic tools and treatment technologies, including advanced imaging techniques, robotic surgery, and modern radiation therapy equipment. This allows for precision in diagnosis and treatment, improving patient outcomes.
  • Holistic Care: At ILS Hospital, we focus on the whole patient, providing not just medical treatments, but emotional and psychological support throughout the cancer journey. Our multidisciplinary team offers a compassionate and supportive environment, where patients and their families are at the heart of everything we do.

Through our comprehensive, patient-centered approach, ILS Hospital strives to provide the best cancer care possible. Whether through surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, or holistic support services, we are dedicated to walking with our patients every step of the way toward recovery.

name: Emergency Medicine
content:
The Emergency Department at ILS Hospitals serves over 20,000 adult and paediatric patients annually. To ensure world-class care, our department adheres to international protocols for managing acute conditions like Heart attacks, Brain strokes, Road traffic accidents, Abdominal Injuries, Fractures, Renal failures, Respiratory failures. We regularly collect and review network-wide data to enhance the quality of care continuously. Our motto, “Your Health, Our Happiness,” drives us to provide high-quality care and treatment.

Patients can expect safe, effective, patient-centered, timely, efficient, and equitable care at all times. Our key focus areas include:

  • Trained staff and Qualified Doctors: Our team is skilled, qualified, and continuously trained.
  • World-Class Infrastructure: Our facilities include well-equipped waiting areas, vulnerable area care, triage systems, and equipment maintenance.
  • Emergency Protocols: We follow established protocols for conditions like head injuries, heart attacks, strokes, and sepsis, ensuring timely and appropriate care.
  • Coordinated Care: We ensure seamless care coordination throughout the patient’s journey.
  • Monitoring Outcomes: We regularly monitor outcomes such as mortality and morbidity, as well as patient complaints, to identify areas for improvement.
  • Commitment to Resources: We are committed to providing adequate resources, including finance, equipment, and infrastructure, to support our staff and ensure optimal patient care.

Our active and engaged management ensures that our Emergency Department is empowered and motivated to deliver exceptional care to every patient who walks through our doors.

name: Spine Surgery
heading: Spine Surgery
content:
Spine Surgery

The spine is one of the most vital structures in the human body, providing support, mobility, and protection to the spinal cord. Any disorder or injury affecting the spine can severely impact quality of life, causing pain, reduced mobility, or even neurological deficits. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Spine Surgery is dedicated to delivering comprehensive, advanced, and patient-focused care for a wide range of spinal conditions, from simple disc problems to complex deformities and injuries.

Comprehensive Spine Care

ILS Hospitals offers specialized services for both degenerative and non-degenerative spine disorders, including:

  • Herniated or slipped discs
  • Spinal stenosis
  • Scoliosis and kyphosis
  • Degenerative disc disease
  • Spinal fractures and trauma
  • Spinal tumors
  • Sciatica and nerve compression syndromes
  • Infections and inflammatory spinal disorders

The department caters to both adults and children, ensuring tailored treatment strategies for each patient’s unique needs.

Expert Team and Multidisciplinary Approach

The Spine Surgery department is led by highly experienced spine surgeons, orthopaedic specialists, and neurosurgeons, supported by a skilled team of anaesthesiologists, physiotherapists, and pain management experts. Collaboration between these specialists ensures comprehensive diagnosis, optimal treatment planning, and effective post-operative care.

Advanced Diagnostic and Surgical Facilities

ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art imaging and surgical facilities to ensure precise diagnosis and successful outcomes. This includes high-resolution MRI and CT scans, digital X-rays, and intraoperative imaging systems that provide real-time guidance during surgery.

Range of Surgical Procedures

The department offers both conventional and minimally invasive spine surgery (MISS) techniques, depending on the condition and patient profile. Minimally invasive methods are preferred where possible, as they cause less tissue damage, reduce post-operative pain, and speed up recovery. Common procedures include:

  • Discectomy / Microdiscectomy – removal of herniated disc material to relieve nerve pressure
  • Laminectomy / Laminotomy – removal of part of the vertebral bone to ease spinal cord or nerve compression
  • Spinal Fusion – joining two or more vertebrae to stabilize the spine
  • Vertebroplasty & Kyphoplasty – injection of bone cement to treat vertebral fractures
  • Deformity Correction Surgery – for scoliosis or kyphosis correction
  • Endoscopic Spine Surgery – advanced, minimally invasive approach for faster recovery

Rehabilitation and Recovery

At ILS Hospitals, spine surgery is only part of the healing journey. Comprehensive rehabilitation programs, led by expert physiotherapists, focus on restoring mobility, improving strength, and preventing recurrence. Personalized exercise plans, lifestyle modifications, and ergonomic advice form an integral part of long-term spine health management.

Patient Safety and Comfort

Patient well-being is the top priority. Every surgery is performed with strict adherence to safety protocols, infection control measures, and advanced anaesthesia techniques. Pre-operative counseling, along with detailed post-operative care instructions, ensures that patients and their families feel informed and supported throughout the process.

The Spine Surgery department at ILS Hospitals combines medical expertise, advanced technology, and compassionate care to offer world-class treatment for spinal disorders. Whether it is relieving chronic pain, correcting deformities, or addressing traumatic injuries, the goal remains the same—restoring mobility, reducing discomfort, and improving the overall quality of life for every patient. With its holistic approach and commitment to excellence, ILS Hospitals stands as a trusted destination for comprehensive spine care.

Comprehensive Spine Care ILS Hospitals offers specialized services for both degenerative and non-degenerative spine disorders, including: Herniated or slipped discs Spinal stenosis Scoliosis and kyphosis Degenerative disc disease Spinal fractures and trauma Spinal tumors Sciatica and nerve compression syndromes Infections and inflammatory spinal disorders The department caters to both adults and children, ensuring tailored treatment strategies for each patient’s unique needs. Expert Team and Multidisciplinary Approach The Spine Surgery department is led by highly experienced spine surgeons, orthopaedic specialists, and neurosurgeons, supported by a skilled team of anaesthesiologists, physiotherapists, and pain management experts. Collaboration between these specialists ensures comprehensive diagnosis, optimal treatment planning, and effective post-operative care. Advanced Diagnostic and Surgical Facilities ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art imaging and surgical facilities to ensure precise diagnosis and successful outcomes. This includes high-resolution MRI and CT scans, digital X-rays, and intraoperative imaging systems that provide real-time guidance during surgery. Range of Surgical Procedures The department offers both conventional and minimally invasive spine surgery (MISS) techniques, depending on the condition and patient profile. Minimally invasive methods are preferred where possible, as they cause less tissue damage, reduce post-operative pain, and speed up recovery. Common procedures include: Discectomy / Microdiscectomy – removal of herniated disc material to relieve nerve pressure Laminectomy / Laminotomy – removal of part of the vertebral bone to ease spinal cord or nerve compression Spinal Fusion – joining two or more vertebrae to stabilize the spine Vertebroplasty & Kyphoplasty – injection of bone cement to treat vertebral fractures Deformity Correction Surgery – for scoliosis or kyphosis correction Endoscopic Spine Surgery – advanced, minimally invasive approach for faster recovery Rehabilitation and Recovery At ILS Hospitals, spine surgery is only part of the healing journey. Comprehensive rehabilitation programs, led by expert physiotherapists, focus on restoring mobility, improving strength, and preventing recurrence. Personalized exercise plans, lifestyle modifications, and ergonomic advice form an integral part of long-term spine health management. Patient Safety and Comfort Patient well-being is the top priority. Every surgery is performed with strict adherence to safety protocols, infection control measures, and advanced anaesthesia techniques. Pre-operative counseling, along with detailed post-operative care instructions, ensures that patients and their families feel informed and supported throughout the process. The Spine Surgery department at ILS Hospitals combines medical expertise, advanced technology, and compassionate care to offer world-class treatment for spinal disorders. Whether it is relieving chronic pain, correcting deformities, or addressing traumatic injuries, the goal remains the same—restoring mobility, reducing discomfort, and improving the overall quality of life for every patient. With its holistic approach and commitment to excellence, ILS Hospitals stands as a trusted destination for comprehensive spine care.

name: Bariatric Surgery
heading: Transform Your Life with Bariatric Surgery at ILS Hospitals: Your Partner in Weight Loss Journey
content:
Transform Your Life with Bariatric Surgery at ILS Hospitals: Your Partner in Weight Loss Journey

Bariatric surgery, also known as weight loss surgery, is a transformative treatment option for individuals struggling with morbid obesity. It stands out as one of the most effective methods for achieving substantial weight loss and maintaining it in the long run. Beyond weight reduction, bariatric surgery brings about significant improvements in obesity-related comorbid conditions, including Type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure, joint pain, sleep disorders like sleep apnoea, heart diseases, infertility, and more.

At ILS Hospitals, we understand the life-changing impact of bariatric surgery. Our state-of-the-art facilities, skilled surgeons, and patient-centric approach make us a leading choice for those seeking effective and safe weight loss solutions.

Why Choose Bariatric Surgery at ILS Hospitals:

Minimally Invasive Laparoscopic Technique:

Bariatric surgery at ILS Hospitals is performed using advanced laparoscopic techniques, ensuring minimal invasiveness. Most patients are up and about on the same day of the surgery, promoting quicker recovery.

Comprehensive Weight Loss Options:

We offer a range of bariatric surgical procedures, each carefully selected based on individual evaluations and counselling by our expert bariatric surgeons. Options include:

  • Gastric Bypass
  • Sleeve Gastrectomy
  • Mini Gastric Bypass
  • Gastric Bands

Benefits of Bariatric Weight Loss Surgery:

Bariatric surgery is not just about shedding excess weight; it’s about reclaiming a healthier life. The procedure helps in reducing the risk of life-threatening weight-related health issues, such as:

  • Type 2 Diabetes
  • High Blood Pressure
  • Heart Disease
  • Severe Sleep Apnoea
  • Osteoarthritis
  • Infertility
  • Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
  • Some Types of Cancer

Risks and Considerations:

While bariatric surgery is generally safe and effective, like any surgical procedure, it comes with potential risks. These may include infection, bleeding, anastomotic leaks, blood clots in legs, and anaesthesia-related issues. Long-term, non-compliant patients may experience deficiencies, with Vitamin B12 deficiency being the most common, but effectively manageable.

Results of Bariatric Surgery:

Bariatric surgery and weight loss treatments at ILS Hospitals offer long-term weight loss results. The amount of weight lost depends on the type of surgery and lifestyle changes adopted. On average, individuals can expect to lose approximately 70% of their excess body weight within two years, significantly enhancing overall health and well-being.

Why ILS Hospitals for Bariatric Surgery:

Expert Bariatric Surgeons:Our experienced bariatric surgeons are among the best in India, ensuring a safe and successful surgical experience.

Comprehensive Post-Surgery Support:We provide thorough post-surgery support, including dietary guidance, lifestyle recommendations, and regular follow-ups for sustained success.

Quality Healthcare at Affordable Cost:The bariatric or weight loss surgery cost at ILS Hospitals is notably lower compared to Western counterparts, without compromising on the quality of care.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs):

What is weight loss surgery?
Weight loss surgery, also known as bariatric surgery, is a surgical procedure designed to help obese individuals lose weight by modifying the digestive system.

Who is eligible for weight loss surgery?
 Candidates typically have a BMI of 35 or more (or lesser with obesity-related health conditions) and have not had success with non-surgical weight loss methods.

What are some different types of weight loss surgeries?
Popular options include gastric bypass, gastric sleeve, adjustable gastric banding, and biliopancreatic diversion with a duodenal switch.

How does gastric bypass surgery work?
It involves creating a stomach pouch and rerouting the digestive tract, reducing food consumption and limiting calorie absorption.

What is the procedure for gastric sleeve surgery?
A portion of the stomach is permanently removed, leaving a smaller sleeve-shaped stomach, reducing food intake by causing early satiety.

Is weight loss surgery reversible?
While some surgeries, like gastric banding, are reversible, others, like sleeve gastrectomy, are generally considered permanent procedures.

What are the potential risks and complications of weight loss surgery?
Risks include infection, bleeding, blood clots, gallstones, nutritional deficiencies, or other long-term complications related to the altered digestive system.

How much weight could I expect to lose after weight loss surgery?
The amount of weight lost depends on the type of surgery, adherence to dietary and lifestyle changes, and individual factors.

Can weight loss surgery improve fertility?
Yes, it can improve fertility by correcting hormonal imbalance and reducing weight-related infertility issues.

Can weight loss surgery be performed on adolescents?
In some cases, it might be an option for severely obese adolescents after careful evaluation and multidisciplinary assessment.

Can weight loss surgery help with long-term weight management?
Weight loss surgery is a tool for significant weight loss, but long-term management requires consistent lifestyle changes, follow-up care, and support.

Embark on your journey to a healthier, happier life with bariatric surgery at ILS Hospitals. Our commitment to your well-being, combined with the expertise of our surgeons, ensures a safe and transformative experience. Book an appointment today and take the first step towards a healthier you!

name: Cardiology (Clinical)
heading: Welcome to ILS Hospitals – Your Heart Health Destination
content:
Welcome to ILS Hospitals – Your Heart Health Destination

At ILS Hospitals, we understand the critical role your heart plays in your overall health and well-being. Cardiovascular disease, often referred to as heart disease, is a significant concern. As a leading healthcare institution, we’re committed to providing top-notch cardiac care to our patients. Our dedicated Cardiology Department at ILS Hospitals is equipped with cutting-edge technology and staffed by highly skilled cardiologists to offer a wide range of cardiac treatments and procedures.

Our Comprehensive Cardiac Services:

We take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive cardiac care, offering advanced treatments for various heart conditions, including:

  • Pacemaker, ACD, CRT: For patients with end-stage heart failure, we offer life-saving procedures such as pacemakers, ACD (Automatic Cardioverter-Defibrillator), and CRT (Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy).
  • Heart Hole Surgeries (ASD, VSD, PDA): Our surgical team specializes in repairing congenital heart defects, including Atrial Septal Defect (ASD), Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD), and Patent Ductus Arteriosus (PDA).
  • Paediatric Cardiac Surgery: We are dedicated to providing specialized care to pediatric patients with congenital heart conditions.
  • Angioplasty/Angiography: We offer interventional procedures, such as angioplasty and angiography, for diagnosing and treating coronary artery diseases.

Invasive and Interventional Cardiology:

At ILS Hospitals, we are your one-stop destination for invasive and interventional cardiology. Our state-of-the-art Cath Labs are equipped with the latest technologies, ensuring our patients receive the best possible care.

Electrophysiology, Pacemaker, and Arrhythmia Services:

We specialize in diagnosing and treating arrhythmias through electrophysiology studies. Our experienced team provides pacemaker implantation and arrhythmia management services.

Abdominal and Descending Thoracic Aneurysm Management:

For patients with abdominal and descending thoracic aneurysms, we offer advanced treatment options. Our expert team ensures that patients receive the highest quality of care and the best possible outcomes.

Varicose Vein Management:

We provide comprehensive care for varicose veins, addressing both the cosmetic and medical aspects of this condition. Our state-of-the-art facilities support the latest varicose vein treatment procedures.

Types of Cardiovascular Diseases:

Cardiovascular diseases come in various forms, including common types such as angina, arrhythmia, heart attack, heart failure, rheumatic heart disease, congenital heart disease, and valvular heart disease.

Comprehensive Diagnosis:

Accurate diagnosis is the foundation of effective treatment. At ILS Hospitals, we employ modern diagnostic tools and expertise to ensure the best care for our patients. Common diagnostic tests include:

  • Blood Tests: Assessing cholesterol levels and other blood components related to heart health.
  • Electrocardiogram (ECG): Recording the electrical activity of the heart to detect irregularities and conditions such as angina and arrhythmias.
  • Echocardiogram: Providing images of the heart’s structure and function.
  • Stress Test: Evaluating the body’s response to exercise to diagnose conditions like angina.
  • Holter Monitoring: Continuous ECG monitoring to detect irregular heart rhythms.
  • Cardiac Catheterization: An invasive procedure providing detailed images of the heart’s coronary arteries and valves.
  • Cardiac CT Scan: Imaging the heart and chest to diagnose heart conditions.
  • Cardiac MRI: Providing 3D images of the heart to aid in diagnosis.

Effective Treatment Options:

Once a diagnosis is made, our expert team tailors treatment options to each patient’s unique needs. These may include:

  • Lifestyle Changes: Encouraging a healthy lifestyle, including diet, exercise, and quitting smoking and alcohol.
  • Medications: Prescribing medications when lifestyle changes are insufficient to manage heart diseases.
  • Pacemakers or ICD: Implanting devices to control irregular heartbeats in patients with arrhythmias.
  • Surgery: Surgical interventions are performed in severe cases, such as coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve replacement or repair, percutaneous coronary intervention, and heart transplant.

At ILS Hospitals, we prioritize your heart health and well-being. Our goal is to provide the best cardiac care to our patients, and we are committed to offering advanced, compassionate, and individualized care.

name: Cardiology (Interventional)
heading: Welcome to ILS Hospitals – Your Heart Health Destination
content:
Welcome to ILS Hospitals – Your Heart Health Destination

At ILS Hospitals, we understand the critical role your heart plays in your overall health and well-being. Cardiovascular disease, often referred to as heart disease, is a significant concern. As a leading healthcare institution, we’re committed to providing top-notch cardiac care to our patients. Our dedicated Cardiology Department at ILS Hospitals is equipped with cutting-edge technology and staffed by highly skilled cardiologists to offer a wide range of cardiac treatments and procedures.

Our Comprehensive Cardiac Services:

We take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive cardiac care, offering advanced treatments for various heart conditions, including:

  • Pacemaker, ACD, CRT: For patients with end-stage heart failure, we offer life-saving procedures such as pacemakers, ACD (Automatic Cardioverter-Defibrillator), and CRT (Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy).
  • Heart Hole Surgeries (ASD, VSD, PDA): Our surgical team specializes in repairing congenital heart defects, including Atrial Septal Defect (ASD), Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD), and Patent Ductus Arteriosus (PDA).
  • Paediatric Cardiac Surgery: We are dedicated to providing specialized care to pediatric patients with congenital heart conditions.
  • Angioplasty/Angiography: We offer interventional procedures, such as angioplasty and angiography, for diagnosing and treating coronary artery diseases.

Invasive and Interventional Cardiology:

At ILS Hospitals, we are your one-stop destination for invasive and interventional cardiology. Our state-of-the-art Cath Labs are equipped with the latest technologies, ensuring our patients receive the best possible care.

Electrophysiology, Pacemaker, and Arrhythmia Services:

We specialize in diagnosing and treating arrhythmias through electrophysiology studies. Our experienced team provides pacemaker implantation and arrhythmia management services.

Abdominal and Descending Thoracic Aneurysm Management:

For patients with abdominal and descending thoracic aneurysms, we offer advanced treatment options. Our expert team ensures that patients receive the highest quality of care and the best possible outcomes.

Varicose Vein Management:

We provide comprehensive care for varicose veins, addressing both the cosmetic and medical aspects of this condition. Our state-of-the-art facilities support the latest varicose vein treatment procedures.

Types of Cardiovascular Diseases:

Cardiovascular diseases come in various forms, including common types such as angina, arrhythmia, heart attack, heart failure, rheumatic heart disease, congenital heart disease, and valvular heart disease.

Comprehensive Diagnosis:

Accurate diagnosis is the foundation of effective treatment. At ILS Hospitals, we employ modern diagnostic tools and expertise to ensure the best care for our patients. Common diagnostic tests include:

  • Blood Tests: Assessing cholesterol levels and other blood components related to heart health.
  • Electrocardiogram (ECG): Recording the electrical activity of the heart to detect irregularities and conditions such as angina and arrhythmias.
  • Echocardiogram: Providing images of the heart’s structure and function.
  • Stress Test: Evaluating the body’s response to exercise to diagnose conditions like angina.
  • Holter Monitoring: Continuous ECG monitoring to detect irregular heart rhythms.
  • Cardiac Catheterization: An invasive procedure providing detailed images of the heart’s coronary arteries and valves.
  • Cardiac CT Scan: Imaging the heart and chest to diagnose heart conditions.
  • Cardiac MRI: Providing 3D images of the heart to aid in diagnosis.

Effective Treatment Options:

Once a diagnosis is made, our expert team tailors treatment options to each patient’s unique needs. These may include:

  • Lifestyle Changes: Encouraging a healthy lifestyle, including diet, exercise, and quitting smoking and alcohol.
  • Medications: Prescribing medications when lifestyle changes are insufficient to manage heart diseases.
  • Pacemakers or ICD: Implanting devices to control irregular heartbeats in patients with arrhythmias.
  • Surgery: Surgical interventions are performed in severe cases, such as coronary artery bypass grafting, heart valve replacement or repair, percutaneous coronary intervention, and heart transplant.

At ILS Hospitals, we prioritize your heart health and well-being. Our goal is to provide the best cardiac care to our patients, and we are committed to offering advanced, compassionate, and individualized care.

name: Critical Care
heading: ILS Hospitals’ Advanced Critical Care Unit: Unparalleled Care for Critical Conditions
content:
ILS Hospitals’ Advanced Critical Care Unit: Unparalleled Care for Critical Conditions

The Critical Care Unit at ILS Hospitals is an advanced and specialized facility designed to deliver exceptional medical care and continuous monitoring for critically ill or injured patients. Our Intensive Care Unit (ICU) surpasses the capabilities of standard hospital rooms, ensuring close monitoring and specialized medical treatments for individuals in critical conditions.

Comprehensive Care at the Department of Critical Care Medicine:

In times when critical care is essential for you or your loved one, access to advanced medical technology, experienced physicians, and skilled nursing staff becomes imperative. At ILS Hospitals’ Department of Critical Care Medicine, we are dedicated to providing the highest level of comprehensive care that encompasses these three crucial elements.

Our department comprises a closely-knit, multidisciplinary team of experts who collaborate seamlessly. As a centre of academic excellence, we boast state-of-the-art infrastructure and the latest technology. Our commitment to advancing medical knowledge is evident through our prestigious fellowship program in Critical Care, active participation in research, and numerous publications in national and international journals.

Key Features of Our Critical Care Services:

  • Disease-Specific Care Plans: Our patient-centric approach involves disease-specific care plans grounded in evidence-based practices.
  • Antibiotic Stewardship: We prioritize antibiotic stewardship, ensuring the responsible use of antibiotics for optimal patient outcomes.
  • Integration of Research Advancements: We stay at the forefront of medical advancements by integrating the latest research findings into our clinical practices.

Handling a Broad Spectrum of Medical Conditions:

Our Critical Care Unit is fully equipped to manage a diverse range of medical conditions, including but not limited to:

  • Acute kidney injury
  • Acute liver failure
  • Acute respiratory failure, ARDS
  • Acute coronary syndrome
  • Cardiogenic shock
  • Cerebral edema
  • Congenital metabolic disorders
  • Drug overdose
  • Gastrointestinal emergencies
  • Heart failure
  • Influenza
  • Intracranial haemorrhage
  • Metabolic disorders
  • Multiple organ failure
  • Obstetric emergencies
  • Pneumonia
  • Pulmonary embolism
  • Sepsis
  • Septic shock
  • Stroke

Moreover, our Critical Care Services extend support to patients requiring post-surgical care or those in the process of recovering from a serious illness.

Count on ILS Hospitals for Unmatched Critical Care:

When you or your loved ones need it the most, trust ILS Hospitals’ Critical Care Unit to provide exceptional care. Leveraging advanced medical technology, experienced professionals, and a patient-centered approach, we are dedicated to ensuring the best possible outcomes for individuals facing critical medical conditions.

mainEntity.name: What are the visiting hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visiting hours are as followed: Ward/Twin Sharing/Cabin/Suite: 9am - 10am | 5pm - 7pm ITU/ICU/CCU/NICU/HDU: 5pm - 6pm | 9am - 10am (Saltlake only)

mainEntity.name: Rules and guidelines for visitors

acceptedAnswer.text: Visitors must carry visitor pass. Only two persons are allowed during visiting hours at Ward/Twin Sharing/Cabin/Suite and only one person is allowed during visiting hours at ITU/ICU/CCU/NICU/HDU. Children are strictly not allowed in critical care areas.

mainEntity.name: Is outside food allowed into the hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outside medicines and foods are not allowed within hospital premises. Patient meals are served as per instruction of the doctor and dietician.

mainEntity.name: What is the mode of payment in your hospital?

mainEntity.name: Is advance payment must for an emergency case?

acceptedAnswer.text: During emergency every minute is vital so the admission is done immediately without any advance deposit money and the patient is taken under medical observation.

mainEntity.name: Do you have any health check up packages?

acceptedAnswer.text: ILS Hospitals are equipped with the latest and accurate testing equipments, trained technicians and specialists providing an advance range of health check up and screening services. acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, 24 x 7 Emergency care service is available at the hospitals.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Dialysis facility is available at ILS Hospitals Agartala and ILS Hospitals Dumdum.

name: CTVS
heading: Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery (CTVS)
content:
Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery (CTVS)

Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery (CTVS) is one of the most advanced and life-saving specialties in modern medicine, dedicated to the diagnosis, surgical treatment, and management of diseases affecting the heart, lungs, chest, and major blood vessels. At ILS Hospitals, the CTVS department brings together cutting-edge surgical techniques, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and highly experienced surgeons to deliver exceptional outcomes for patients requiring complex cardiac, thoracic, or vascular interventions.

Scope of CTVS at ILS Hospitals

The CTVS team at ILS Hospitals offers a comprehensive range of surgical solutions for conditions such as coronary artery disease, heart valve disorders, congenital heart defects, aortic aneurysms, peripheral artery disease, lung tumors, and other thoracic abnormalities. Whether it’s a minimally invasive heart bypass, a delicate valve replacement, or intricate vascular reconstruction, the department ensures precision and safety in every procedure.

Advanced Technology and Facilities

ILS Hospitals is equipped with modern cardiac operating theatres featuring laminar airflow systems, advanced heart-lung machines, and real-time imaging technology. These facilities enable surgeons to perform both open and minimally invasive surgeries with reduced risks, faster recovery, and better long-term results. Post-surgery, patients receive care in specialized Cardiac Intensive Care Units (CICUs) managed by skilled critical care teams, ensuring close monitoring and rapid response in the recovery phase.

Highly Skilled Multidisciplinary Team

The success of CTVS procedures depends not only on the surgeon’s expertise but also on a coordinated approach involving anesthesiologists, perfusionists, nurses, and rehabilitation specialists. At ILS Hospitals, the CTVS team works in close collaboration with cardiologists, pulmonologists, and radiologists to ensure accurate diagnosis, meticulous planning, and personalized treatment strategies for each patient.

Minimally Invasive & Advanced Surgical Techniques

In line with global medical advancements, ILS Hospitals embraces minimally invasive surgical approaches wherever possible. These techniques, involving smaller incisions and advanced instrumentation, result in less pain, minimal scarring, shorter hospital stays, and faster return to normal life. For certain high-risk patients, hybrid procedures combining surgical and catheter-based interventions are also offered, ensuring safety without compromising outcomes.

Patient-Centric Approach

ILS Hospitals believes that surgery is just one part of the patient’s healing journey. From pre-operative counseling to post-operative rehabilitation, the hospital focuses on holistic care. Patients and their families are guided through every step, with emphasis on education about lifestyle changes, dietary modifications, and cardiac rehabilitation programs to promote long-term health.

Commitment to Excellence

With an unwavering commitment to precision, safety, and compassionate care, the CTVS department at ILS Hospitals has earned the trust of patients across the region. The hospital continuously invests in training, technology, and research to remain at the forefront of cardiac and thoracic surgery.

Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery is a critical field that saves and improves countless lives. At ILS Hospitals, the blend of surgical expertise, advanced facilities, and a patient-first philosophy ensures that individuals receive world-class care close to home. Whether it’s an emergency life-saving operation or an elective corrective procedure, the CTVS team stands ready to deliver excellence at every stage of care.
