name: Dental Care
heading: ILS Hospitals: Comprehensive Dental Care for a Healthy Smile
content:
ILS Hospitals: Comprehensive Dental Care for a Healthy Smile

Maintaining good dental health involves more than just brushing and flossing; it requires regular check-ups, a healthy diet, and preventive care. At ILS Hospitals, we prioritize your dental well-being, offering a range of services to prevent gum damage, control bad breath, and enhance the longevity of your teeth.

Common Dental Ailments:

Our dental care covers various common issues, including bad breath, caries or cavities, gingivitis or gum diseases, abscesses, tooth loosening, leucoplakia or white patches, and mouth cancer. We specialize in:

  • Implantology
  • Invisible Braces
  • Laser Dentistry (painless soft tissue treatment)
  • Paediatric Dentistry
  • Painless Root Canal Treatment

Understanding Plaque:

The primary culprit behind tooth decay and gum disease is plaque. This sticky combination of bacteria and food begins accumulating on teeth within 20 minutes after eating. If not removed through daily cleaning, plaque leads to tooth decay. Failure to address plaque turns it into tartar, a hard deposit at the tooth’s base. Plaque and tartar cause inflammation, irritation, and infections in the gums, leading to various dental issues.

Consequences of Plaque and Tartar:

  • Cavities: Holes that destroy tooth structure.
  • Gingivitis: Inflammation and bleeding gums due to bacterial infection.
  • Bad Breath (Halitosis):
  • Periodontitis: Destruction of bone and ligaments supporting teeth, potentially leading to tooth loss.
  • Abscesses, Pain, and Tooth Dysfunction:
  • Health Issues beyond the Mouth: Ranging from preterm labour to heart disease.

Preventing plaque formation is key to avoiding these dental problems and maintaining overall oral health.

Importance of Basic Dental Care:

  • Prevents Tooth Decay:
  • Enhances Smile Aesthetics:
  • Avoids Gum Disease: Protects gum tissue and supporting bones, preventing tooth loss.
  • Saves Time and Enhances Dental Visits:
  • Reduces Need for Costly Procedures:
  • Prevents Bad Breath:
  • Keeps Teeth White:
  • Ensures Long-lasting Teeth:
  • Improves Overall Health:

Dental Treatment Options:

At ILS Hospitals, our dental treatments encompass Implantology, invisible braces, laser dentistry, paediatric dentistry, and painless root canals. Equipped with state-of-the-art technologies, our dental clinic addresses preventive and primary healthcare needs. Trust ILS Hospitals for the best dental treatment in India, promoting your oral health and a confident smile.

name: Dermatology
heading: ILS Hospitals: Expert Dermatology Services for Healthy Skin, Hair, and Nails
content:
ILS Hospitals: Expert Dermatology Services for Healthy Skin, Hair, and Nails

The Department of Dermatology at ILS Hospitals is dedicated to providing comprehensive treatment for a wide range of skin, hair, nail, and related disorders. Our skilled dermatologists specialize in various areas, including surgical, cosmetic, and paediatric dermatology. Recognized as one of the top dermatology hospitals, we address both standard and advanced dermatological issues, such as acne, hair loss, psoriasis, sexually transmitted diseases, eczema, and pemphigus.

Our Specialized Services:

  • Surgical, Cosmetic, and Paediatric Dermatology:We offer a spectrum of services catering to surgical, cosmetic, and paediatric dermatology.
  • Advanced Dermatology Disorders:Our expertise extends to the treatment of advanced disorders, including acne, hair loss, psoriasis, sexually transmitted diseases, eczema, and pemphigus.
  • Medical Treatment for Hair Restoration and Transplants:Our dermatologists provide medical treatment options for hair restoration and hair transplant procedures.

Why Choose ILS Hospitals for Skin Treatment:

  • Eczema, Skin Cancer, Acne, Hair Loss, Shingles, Moles:Our skin treatment experts excel in addressing conditions such as eczema, skin cancer, acne, hair loss, shingles, and moles.
  • Comprehensive Dermatology Care:We offer a holistic approach to dermatological care, covering diseases of the oral mucous membrane, genital disorders, sexually transmitted diseases, general dermatology, leg ulcers, and psoriasis.
  • Leukoderma (Vitiligo) Treatment:Specialized treatments, including Vitiligo Grafting and stem cell therapy, are provided for leukoderma (white patches).
  • Experienced Dermatologists:Our team of dermatologists comprises experienced professionals with expertise in both medical and surgical dermatology.

Understanding Dermatology and Dermatologists:

A dermatologist is a medical expert specializing in the treatment of skin, hair, and nail diseases. The skin, being the most visible organ, reflects the body’s overall health. Dermatologists who are skilled in surgical procedures, play a crucial role in maintaining skin health.

Conditions Treated by Medical Dermatologists:

  • Leg Ulcers (Stasis Ulcers):Wounds caused by damaged or abnormal veins are treated through wound care, compression, leg elevation, and, if necessary, surgery.
  • Leukoderma (Vitiligo):Loss of skin colour due to non-functioning pigment-producing cells is controlled through specialized treatments.
  • Psoriasis:A chronic skin condition involving the formation of scales and dry, itchy patches is managed to alleviate symptoms.
  • Acne:Common among young adults, acne is effectively treated with prescribed cleansers, antibiotics, and over-the-counter medicines.
  • Moles:Pigment-producing skin cell disorders are managed, although not cured, by dermatologists.
  • Hair Loss (Alopecia):A common condition with various causes, including hormonal changes, is addressed by dermatologists for timely intervention.
  • Shingles (Herpes Zoster):Painful rashes caused by the reactivation of the chickenpox virus are treated with antiviral medication, and preventive vaccines are available.
  • Eczema:Red, itchy, and scaly rashes are effectively treated, providing relief through appropriate ointments and creams.

At ILS Hospitals, we prioritize your skin health, offering expert dermatological care for a radiant and healthy you. Schedule an appointment today for a brighter and healthier tomorrow.

name: Diabetology & Endocrinology
heading: ILS Hospitals: Comprehensive Diabetes and Endocrinological Care
content:
ILS Hospitals: Comprehensive Diabetes and Endocrinological Care

Diabetes stands as a major contributor to premature illness and deaths globally. Timely diagnosis and treatment are imperative to curb the potential complications associated with diabetes. Often, the absence of symptoms leads to delayed detection, emphasizing the need for proactive health management.

Understanding Diabetes:

Diabetes inhibits the body’s utilization and storage of glucose, necessitating vigilant monitoring to maintain optimal blood sugar levels. The type of diabetes determines its causes and treatment. At ILS Hospitals, recognized as the premier hospital for diabetes care, our highly experienced medical team tailors treatments based on the specific type of diabetes.

The Role of Endocrinology:

Endocrinology focuses on the endocrine organs, such as the thyroid, pancreas, and ovaries, which regulate hormonal balance. Beyond diabetes, various endocrinological diseases require attention and specialized care. Some noteworthy conditions include:

  • Cushing’s Disease: Characterized by excessive cortisol production, leading to symptoms like a fatty hump between shoulders, skin stretch marks, weight gain, skin thinning, and acne.
  • Hyperthyroidism: Occurs when the thyroid gland overproduces hormones, resulting in symptoms like rapid weight loss, sweating, irregular heartbeat, and irritability.
  • Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS): A hormonal disorder affecting women, causing overproduction of male hormones, leading to symptoms such as irregular menstrual cycles, excessive facial hair, and male-pattern baldness.
  • Thyroid Cancer: Uncontrolled production of abnormal cells in the thyroid gland, forming tumours. Symptoms include neck lumps, pain, wheezing, breathing difficulties, and coughing.

State-of-the-Art Diagnosis and Treatment:

At ILS Hospitals, we leverage cutting-edge medical technology for accurate diagnoses. Our medical professionals then recommend the most suitable treatment options, ensuring patients can lead healthy and fulfilling lives.

Treatment Options:

  • Lifestyle Changes: Initial stages of diseases like diabetes may benefit from adopting lifestyle changes to manage and potentially cure symptoms.
  • Medication: Conditions like PCOS and hyperthyroidism are often managed through various medications recommended by our experienced doctors.
  • Continuous Glucose Monitoring: We provide the facility for continuous glucose monitoring, enabling precise tracking of sugar levels for effective diabetes management.

At ILS Hospitals, our commitment to advanced medical care, combined with a personalized approach, makes us the preferred choice for diabetes and endocrinological care. Trust us to provide the expertise and support needed for a healthy and happy life.

name: Dietetics
heading: ILS Hospitals: Embracing Nutritional Wellness for Health and Healing
content:
ILS Hospitals: Embracing Nutritional Wellness for Health and Healing

Your nutritional state plays a pivotal role in either safeguarding you against or predisposing you to chronic diseases. Achieving a balanced nutrition is not just beneficial; it is crucial for optimal health, physical growth, developmental milestones, and the regulation of essential bodily processes. The guidance provided by healthcare specialists regarding nutrition is not mere advice; it is a prescription for a path to better recovery and sustained well-being. In fact, medical treatment for various conditions, including obesity, diabetes, dyslipidaemia, and renal dysfunction, often incorporates diet therapy, underscoring the dual role of nutrition as both a preventive and therapeutic science.

The Role of Nutrition in Health:

Nutrition forms an integral part of both the treatment and prevention of diverse ailments. Embarking on a journey toward sustained good health commences with meaningful dietary changes and regular consultations with a dietician. Seeking nutrition advice and undergoing a comprehensive dietary analysis are essential steps in ensuring that all additional nutritional requirements are met.

Key Aspects of Our Nutritional Wellness Approach:

  • Personalized Nutrition Plans:We recognize that each individual has unique nutritional needs. Our expert dieticians craft personalized nutrition plans tailored to address specific health concerns and goals.
  • Dietary Analysis:A thorough dietary analysis is conducted to evaluate the existing nutritional intake and identify areas for improvement. This process helps in creating a roadmap for achieving optimal nutrition.
  • Preventive Nutrition:We believe that nutrition is not just about addressing existing health issues but also about preventing future ones. Our preventive nutrition strategies aim to fortify your body against potential risks.
  • Therapeutic Nutrition:For individuals undergoing medical treatments for conditions like obesity, diabetes, dyslipidaemia, and renal dysfunction, our therapeutic nutrition plans complement the treatment regimen, promoting holistic healing.
  • Continuous Monitoring and Adjustment:Nutritional needs evolve, and so do health conditions. We ensure continuous monitoring of your nutritional status and make necessary adjustments to the nutrition plan to align with changing requirements.

Why Choose Our Nutritional Wellness Services:

  • Expert Guidance: Our team of experienced dieticians provides expert guidance, ensuring that your nutritional journey is informed and effective.
  • Holistic Approach: We view nutrition as a holistic aspect of health, addressing not just specific conditions but contributing to overall well-being.
  • Collaborative Care: Our dieticians collaborate with other healthcare professionals to integrate nutrition seamlessly into your comprehensive healthcare plan.
  • Education and Empowerment: We believe in educating and empowering individuals to make informed choices about their nutrition, fostering a sustainable and health-conscious lifestyle.

At ILS Hospitals, we are committed to promoting nutritional wellness as a cornerstone of good health. Our comprehensive approach ensures that your nutritional journey is not just a prescription but a personalized path toward sustained well-being.

name: Endocrinology
heading: ILS Hospitals: Comprehensive Diabetes and Endocrinological Care
content:
ILS Hospitals: Comprehensive Diabetes and Endocrinological Care

Diabetes stands as a major contributor to premature illness and deaths globally. Timely diagnosis and treatment are imperative to curb the potential complications associated with diabetes. Often, the absence of symptoms leads to delayed detection, emphasizing the need for proactive health management.

Understanding Diabetes:

Diabetes inhibits the body’s utilization and storage of glucose, necessitating vigilant monitoring to maintain optimal blood sugar levels. The type of diabetes determines its causes and treatment. At ILS Hospitals, recognized as the premier hospital for diabetes care, our highly experienced medical team tailors treatments based on the specific type of diabetes.

The Role of Endocrinology:

Endocrinology focuses on the endocrine organs, such as the thyroid, pancreas, and ovaries, which regulate hormonal balance. Beyond diabetes, various endocrinological diseases require attention and specialized care. Some noteworthy conditions include:

  • Cushing’s Disease: Characterized by excessive cortisol production, leading to symptoms like a fatty hump between shoulders, skin stretch marks, weight gain, skin thinning, and acne.
  • Hyperthyroidism: Occurs when the thyroid gland overproduces hormones, resulting in symptoms like rapid weight loss, sweating, irregular heartbeat, and irritability.
  • Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS): A hormonal disorder affecting women, causing overproduction of male hormones, leading to symptoms such as irregular menstrual cycles, excessive facial hair, and male-pattern baldness.
  • Thyroid Cancer: Uncontrolled production of abnormal cells in the thyroid gland, forming tumours. Symptoms include neck lumps, pain, wheezing, breathing difficulties, and coughing.

State-of-the-Art Diagnosis and Treatment:

At ILS Hospitals, we leverage cutting-edge medical technology for accurate diagnoses. Our medical professionals then recommend the most suitable treatment options, ensuring patients can lead healthy and fulfilling lives.

Treatment Options:

  • Lifestyle Changes: Initial stages of diseases like diabetes may benefit from adopting lifestyle changes to manage and potentially cure symptoms.
  • Medication: Conditions like PCOS and hyperthyroidism are often managed through various medications recommended by our experienced doctors.
  • Continuous Glucose Monitoring: We provide the facility for continuous glucose monitoring, enabling precise tracking of sugar levels for effective diabetes management.

At ILS Hospitals, our commitment to advanced medical care, combined with a personalized approach, makes us the preferred choice for diabetes and endocrinological care. Trust us to provide the expertise and support needed for a healthy and happy life.

name: ENT
heading: ILS Hospitals ENT Department: Comprehensive Care for Ear, Nose, and Throat Health
content:
ILS Hospitals ENT Department: Comprehensive Care for Ear, Nose, and Throat Health

At ILS Hospitals, we recognize the critical role that comprehensive ear, nose, and throat (ENT) care plays in maintaining overall health and well-being. Our dedicated team of highly skilled ENT specialists is committed to providing exceptional care to patients of all ages. Whether you’re dealing with hearing issues, sinus problems, or throat disorders, our experts are here to offer relief and enhance your quality of life.

Our Specialized Services:

  • Otology and Neurotology: Our specialists in otology and neurotology focus on the diagnosis and treatment of various ear-related conditions. From hearing loss and tinnitus to ear infections and balance disorders, our team utilizes state-of-the-art technology for accurate diagnoses. Whether you require a hearing aid fitting or intricate ear surgery, we provide comprehensive care tailored to your specific needs.
  • Rhinology and Sinus Surgery: The rhinology and sinus surgery team specializes in the diagnosis and management of nasal and sinus disorders. If you’re dealing with chronic sinusitis, nasal polyps, or nasal obstructions, our experts conduct thorough evaluations and create personalized treatment plans. We offer minimally invasive procedures like endoscopic sinus surgery for long-term relief and the restoration of normal nasal function.
  • Head and Neck Surgery: Highly experienced in managing a broad spectrum of conditions affecting the head and neck region, our surgeons handle cases from thyroid and parathyroid disorders to salivary gland diseases and throat cancers. We provide comprehensive evaluations, advanced diagnostics, and innovative surgical interventions.
  • Paediatric ENT: Recognizing the unique ENT needs of children, our paediatric ENT specialists diagnose and treat a variety of disorders in a child-friendly environment. From ear infections and tonsillitis to congenital abnormalities and speech disorders, our team delivers compassionate care.
  • Voice and Swallowing Disorders: If you’re experiencing voice changes, swallowing difficulties, or throat discomfort, our specialists in voice and swallowing disorders are equipped to help. Using advanced diagnostic tools like swallowing studies, we accurately diagnose and treat conditions such as vocal cord nodules, acid reflux-related laryngitis, and swallowing disorders.

Surgeries Performed by Our ENT Surgeons:

  • Tympanoplasty – Repair of the eardrum
  • Adenoidectomy – Removal of the adenoids
  • Septoplasty – Correction of the deviated nasal septum
  • Rhinoplasty – Nasal surgery for cosmetic or functional purposes
  • Sinus surgery – Surgery to improve sinus function
  • Otoplasty – Ear reshaping surgery
  • Stapedectomy – Surgery to improve hearing in the middle ear
  • Tonsillectomy – Removal of tonsils
  • Laryngectomy – Removal of the larynx
  • Tracheostomy – Creation of an opening in the trachea
  • Neck dissection – Removal of lymph nodes in the neck
  • Parathyroidectomy – Removal of parathyroid glands
  • Thyroidectomy – Removal of the thyroid gland
  • Salivary gland surgery – Surgery to remove or repair salivary glands

Why Choose ILS Hospitals?

  • Experienced and Skilled Specialists: Our ENT specialists are highly trained, experienced, and dedicated to delivering the highest quality of care. They follow evidence-based practices to ensure optimal outcomes for our patients.
  • Advanced Diagnostic and Treatment Facilities: ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art technology and facilities for accurate diagnoses and effective treatment options. From audiology labs and sleep study centres to dedicated operation theatres and rehabilitation facilities, we have everything needed for comprehensive ENT care.
  • Multidisciplinary Approach: We believe in a collaborative approach to healthcare. Our ENT specialists work closely with other medical disciplines, including neurology, pulmonology, and oncology, providing integrated and holistic care for complex cases.
  • Patient-Centric Care: At ILS Hospitals, your needs and well-being are our top priorities. From the moment you step into our facility until your recovery, our dedicated staff ensures that you receive personalized attention, compassionate care, and support throughout your medical journey.

name: Gastroenterology
heading: Comprehensive Gastroenterology Care at ILS Hospitals
content:
Comprehensive Gastroenterology Care at ILS Hospitals

Gastroenterology is the field of medicine dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of disorders related to the gastrointestinal tract. This intricate branch encompasses the comprehensive understanding of gastrointestinal organs, including the functioning of the liver, digestion, absorption, waste elimination, and more. Gastrointestinal disorders can impact various parts of the digestive system, spanning the stomach, oesophagus, pancreas, gallbladder, liver, and both the small and large intestines. A gastroenterologist possesses extensive scientific knowledge to offer gastroenterology treatment and provide optimal healthcare to patients.

Who is a Gastroenterologist?

A gastroenterologist is a medical specialist who focuses on the field of gastroenterology (DM gastroenterology) and delivers a wide array of medical treatments related to this specialty. These professionals undergo specialized training in managing diseases of the liver and the gastrointestinal tract. Gastroenterologists bring an extensive understanding of presenting symptoms, such as difficulties in swallowing, constipation, heartburn, diarrhoea, vomiting, and gastrointestinal bleeding. They utilize this knowledge to diagnose and treat various conditions effectively. At ILS Hospitals, we are deeply committed to providing top-notch healthcare services to our patients, especially in addressing life-threatening acute medical issues.

Gastroenterologists also engage in substantial research related to gastrointestinal endoscopic treatments and procedures, as well as the interpretation of test results. They are true experts in the field, known for their ability to deliver broad, precise, and comprehensive care to patients dealing with gastrointestinal conditions. Some of the conditions and treatments they handle include peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, oesophageal cancer, colon cancer, and they perform endoscopic therapeutic interventions.

The Significance of Endoscopic Treatment

Endoscopy is an integral aspect of gastroenterological treatment, often employed by doctors to achieve a more accurate diagnosis of a patient’s condition. An endoscope is a flexible tube equipped with a small camera that enables doctors to conduct these tests. Typically, endoscopes are employed to examine various parts of the body, including the urinary tract, respiratory tract, ears, gastrointestinal tract, and the reproductive system.

Gastroenterologists may employ endoscopic procedures to identify the underlying causes of various issues, such as abdominal pain, gastrointestinal bleeding, ulcers, difficulty in swallowing, polyps or growths in the colon, and cancers of the digestive system. Following a successful diagnosis, these experts formulate the most appropriate medical therapy to cure the condition effectively.

Endoscopic treatment offers several advantages, including minimal blood loss, reduced pain, absence of tissue or muscle trauma, and a lower risk of infection. Over the last few decades, the advantages of endoscopic treatment and procedures in the field of gastroenterology have significantly expanded. Correspondingly, the technologies used in gastroenterology treatment have also advanced, thereby reducing the risk of complications. Gastroenterologists play a pivotal role in treating or preventing these issues effectively. During a gastroenterology consultation, gastroenterologists evaluate whether the potential benefits of endoscopic procedures outweigh their associated risks when deciding whether to employ them.

How Gastroenterology Treatment Works

A typical gastroenterology treatment begins at a gastroenterologist’s clinic or a hospital. The process involves the clinic staff recording the patient’s vital signs, including blood pressure, heart rate, and weight. They also compile a comprehensive list of the patient’s medications, allergies, and medical history. During the consultation, the doctor may conduct various tests, such as lab tests, X-Rays, motility tests, and endoscopic procedures and interventions. The entire visit usually lasts around 30 minutes to an hour, or longer if the gastroenterologist performs endoscopic procedures concurrently. This thorough process ensures the precise diagnosis and effective treatment of gastrointestinal conditions.

name: General and Laparoscopic Surgery
heading: Revolutionizing Surgery: The Art of Minimal Access Surgery at ILS Hospitals
content:
Revolutionizing Surgery: The Art of Minimal Access Surgery at ILS Hospitals

Minimal Access Surgery, also known as Laparoscopic Surgery, is a ground-breaking technique transforming the landscape of surgical procedures. Unlike traditional open surgery with large incisions, this method involves small, keyhole incisions through which a laparoscopic surgeon navigates a telescope with a video camera, providing a visual guide on a TV monitor.

In the realm of minimal access surgery, the surgeon’s precision is enhanced, and patients benefit from reduced pain, quicker recovery, and superior cosmetic results. The technique is applied to various areas, termed laparoscopy in the abdomen, arthroscopy in joints, and thoracoscopy in the chest.

Advantages of Minimal Access Surgery:

Quick Recovery Time:

  • Patients are up and about within a few hours after surgery.
  • Rapid resumption of daily activities.

Small Incisions:

  • Keyhole incisions replace large cuts, minimizing trauma to tissues.

Less Discomfort:

  • Patients experience minimal pain compared to traditional open surgery.

Shorter Hospital Stays:

  • Reduced recovery time translates to shorter hospital stays.

Less Internal Scarring:

  • The technique minimizes internal scarring, enhancing cosmetic outcomes.

Conditions Treated with Minimal Access Surgery:

  • Thyroid and Parathyroid Disorders
  • Hernia
  • Appendix Conditions
  • Anorectal Conditions
  • Gastrointestinal Tract Diseases
  • Gall Bladder Stones
  • Pancreatic, Adrenal Gland, Spleen, Kidney, and Liver Conditions

The Minimal Access, Metabolic, and Bariatric Surgery team at ILS Hospitals has pioneered and propagated this technique for over 20 years. Comprising renowned surgeons like Dr.Om Tantia, the team boasts two decades of collaboration, ensuring surgical excellence and optimal patient outcomes.

Experience the future of surgery at ILS Hospitals. Book an appointment with the leading laparoscopic surgery hospital in India and embark on a journey to faster recovery and superior care.

name: General Medicine
heading: General Medicine
content:
General Medicine

General Medicine is the foundation of healthcare, providing comprehensive medical care for adults and addressing a wide spectrum of acute and chronic illnesses. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of General Medicine plays a pivotal role in diagnosing, treating, and preventing diseases while focusing on the overall well-being of patients. This specialty is often the first point of contact for individuals seeking medical attention, offering holistic, patient-centric care supported by advanced diagnostic facilities and multidisciplinary expertise.

Scope of Services

The General Medicine department at ILS Hospitals manages a variety of health conditions, including infections, metabolic disorders, respiratory illnesses, gastrointestinal problems, hypertension, diabetes, thyroid disorders, and autoimmune diseases. The team also provides care for multi-system disorders, complex undiagnosed cases, and preventive health needs. By addressing both minor ailments and complex medical issues, the department ensures continuity of care for patients of all ages.

Expert Medical Team

ILS Hospitals houses a team of highly qualified physicians with extensive experience in internal medicine. These specialists are adept at evaluating symptoms, conducting thorough clinical assessments, and formulating personalized treatment plans. With a strong emphasis on evidence-based medicine, the doctors work closely with other specialists such as cardiologists, neurologists, gastroenterologists, and endocrinologists when specialized intervention is required, ensuring seamless patient care.

State-of-the-Art Diagnostic Support

Accurate diagnosis is the foundation of effective treatment, and ILS Hospitals is equipped with modern laboratory services, advanced imaging facilities, and a comprehensive pathology department. This enables physicians to perform in-depth evaluations, monitor treatment progress, and detect potential complications early. From routine blood tests to advanced radiological investigations, every aspect of diagnostics is designed to support prompt and precise medical decisions.

Preventive and Lifestyle Medicine

The General Medicine department places strong emphasis on preventive healthcare. Regular health check-ups, vaccinations, and lifestyle counseling are encouraged to reduce the risk of chronic diseases. Physicians at ILS Hospitals provide guidance on healthy eating, exercise, stress management, and other lifestyle modifications to help patients lead healthier lives and avoid preventable illnesses.

Chronic Disease Management

Managing long-term conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, asthma, and heart disease requires consistent monitoring and individualized care. At ILS Hospitals, chronic disease management programs focus on patient education, adherence to treatment, and regular follow-ups. By empowering patients with knowledge and self-care strategies, the hospital helps improve quality of life and reduce complications.

Emergency and Acute Care

The department is also skilled in handling acute medical conditions, including infections, allergic reactions, asthma attacks, and other sudden illnesses. With 24/7 emergency services and access to advanced critical care units, patients receive timely and effective treatment during urgent situations.

Patient-Centric Approach

Every patient at ILS Hospitals is treated with compassion and respect. The General Medicine team listens attentively to concerns, explains diagnoses in clear terms, and involves patients in every decision about their care. This collaborative approach fosters trust and encourages better health outcomes.
The General Medicine department at ILS Hospitals is more than just a treatment center—it is a trusted healthcare partner committed to lifelong wellness. By combining medical expertise, advanced diagnostics, and a compassionate approach, the department ensures patients receive the highest standard of care, whether for routine check-ups, complex medical conditions, or preventive health.

name: Geriatric Medicine
heading: Geriatric Medicine
content:
Geriatric Medicine

Geriatric Medicine is a specialized branch of healthcare dedicated to meeting the unique medical, psychological, and social needs of older adults. As life expectancy increases, the demand for specialized care for the elderly has grown significantly. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Geriatric Medicine is committed to enhancing the quality of life for senior citizens through comprehensive, compassionate, and specialized care tailored to the challenges of aging.

Comprehensive Care for the Elderly

Older adults often face multiple health concerns, ranging from chronic illnesses like diabetes, hypertension, arthritis, and heart disease to cognitive disorders such as dementia and Alzheimer’s. They may also experience mobility issues, vision or hearing impairment, and nutritional deficiencies. The Geriatric Medicine team at ILS Hospitals addresses these complex needs with a holistic approach, ensuring that physical, mental, and emotional health are equally prioritized.

Expert Team of Specialists

ILS Hospitals is home to a team of highly skilled geriatricians, physicians, nurses, physiotherapists, dietitians, and social workers who work together to provide coordinated care. These professionals have expertise in managing multiple health conditions simultaneously, prescribing safe medication regimens, and ensuring treatments are suitable for older bodies that may respond differently to standard therapies.

Advanced Diagnostic and Support Services

Accurate assessment is crucial in geriatric care. ILS Hospitals is equipped with modern diagnostic tools, imaging facilities, and laboratory services to detect health problems early and monitor ongoing conditions. Specialized screenings for cognitive health, bone density, cardiovascular risk, and nutritional status help create individualized treatment plans that are both preventive and therapeutic.

Chronic Disease & Polypharmacy Management

Many elderly patients require long-term treatment for multiple conditions, often involving multiple medications. The Geriatric Medicine team at ILS Hospitals focuses on minimizing the risks of polypharmacy—where taking several medications increases the chances of drug interactions or side effects. Medication plans are regularly reviewed to ensure safety and effectiveness.

Rehabilitation and Mobility Support

Maintaining independence is a key goal in geriatric care. ILS Hospitals provides physiotherapy and occupational therapy services to help elderly patients recover from surgeries, strokes, or fractures, and to manage degenerative conditions like osteoarthritis. Mobility aids, exercise programs, and home safety recommendations are also offered to enhance daily living and reduce the risk of falls.

Mental Health and Emotional Well-being

Older adults are more susceptible to depression, anxiety, and loneliness. At ILS Hospitals, emotional well-being is an integral part of care. Counseling services, support groups, and social engagement activities are encouraged to promote a positive outlook and improve quality of life.

Preventive Health & Wellness

Preventive care is equally important for the elderly. The department emphasizes regular health check-ups, vaccinations, balanced nutrition, and lifestyle guidance to maintain strength and resilience against illnesses. Family counseling sessions help caregivers understand and support the needs of elderly loved ones more effectively.

At ILS Hospitals, Geriatric Medicine is not just about treating illnesses—it’s about empowering older adults to live with dignity, comfort, and independence. Through expert medical care, advanced diagnostics, and a compassionate, patient-first approach, the department ensures that every senior receives the attention and respect they deserve in their golden years.

name: Haematology
heading: ILS Hospitals: Advancing Haematology Care for Blood Disorders
content:
ILS Hospitals: Advancing Haematology Care for Blood Disorders

Haematology, a subspecialty within internal medicine, is dedicated to the study, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases related to blood components. This encompasses blood cells, proteins, platelets, haemoglobin, and blood vessels, along with blood-forming organs like bone marrow and the spleen.

Our specialized team of haematologists at ILS Hospitals addresses both benign and malignant disorders of platelets, red and white blood cells, immunocytes, and coagulation systems in both children and adults. We are equipped to handle a spectrum of conditions, ranging from routine blood disorders to complex cases requiring advanced interventions.

Specializations in Haematology:

  • Hemoglobinopathy: Focuses on disorders related to abnormal production or molecular structure of haemoglobin. Common conditions include haemoglobin C disease, haemoglobin S-C disease, sickle cell anaemia, and Thalassemia.
  • Haematological Malignancy: Involves cancers originating in the bone marrow or immune system cells, such as leukaemia, lymphoma, and multiple myeloma. These cancers result from uncontrolled division of abnormal cells.
  • Coagulopathy: Deals with bleeding disorders, specifically the formation of blood clots in the body. Conditions like haemophilia make it challenging for the body to control bleeding.
  • Anaemia: Encompasses health conditions where there’s a deficiency of red blood cells, leading to inadequate oxygen supply to body tissues. Types of anaemia include Aplastic anaemia, Iron deficiency anaemia, Sickle cell anaemia, Thalassemia, and Vitamin deficiency anaemia.

Common Symptoms of Blood Abnormalities:

  • Excessive bleeding or bruising
  • Frequent and unexplained nosebleeds
  • Recurring infections
  • Shortness of breath
  • Dizziness or headache
  • Pale skin
  • Fever and sudden weight loss
  • Night sweats
  • Fatigue or weakness
  • Chest pain, head, and neck pain
  • Vomiting
  • Joint swelling and stiffness

When to Consult a Haematologist:

If you are diagnosed with any blood disorder or experience:

  • Prolonged fever not responding to routine therapy
  • Nodes in the body not responding to routine therapy
  • Abnormal blood counts (high or low white blood cell or platelet counts)
  • Bleeding manifestations
  • Clotting issues
  • Recurrent infections
  • Prolonged or excessive bleeding
  • Blood in the urine
  • Persistent symptoms

Diseases Treated by Haematologists:

Haematologists collaborate with healthcare professionals to treat various conditions, including:

  • Anaemia
  • Blood cancer
  • Lymphoma or myeloma
  • Aplastic anaemia
  • Bone marrow failure syndromes
  • Myelodysplastic syndrome
  • Myeloproliferative disease
  • Myelofibrosis
  • Hemochromatosis (excess iron absorption)
  • Hemoglobinopathy (Thalassemia, Sickle Cell Anaemia)
  • Polycythaemia
  • Blood coagulation disorders
  • Blood clots
  • Von Willebrand disease
  • Bleeding disorders (Haemophilia, Vitamin K deficiency)

Diagnostic Approaches:

To diagnose and treat various blood disorders, our haematologists employ a range of diagnostic techniques:

  • Blood Test: Evaluates abnormalities by checking protein levels in red and white blood cells, assessing various blood conditions.
  • Complete Blood Cell Count (CBC) and Peripheral Smear: Assesses blood factors like red and white blood cells, haemoglobin, plasma, and platelets, helping detect underlying blood diseases.
  • Bone Marrow Aspiration and Biopsy: Examines bone marrow tissue for diseases, aiding in the diagnosis of bone marrow disorders and cancers.
  • Platelet Count: Measures platelet levels to identify conditions like thrombocytopenia and thrombocytosis.
  • Blood Enzyme Tests: Identifies tissue damage or diseases by measuring proteins and enzymes in the blood.
  • Complete Iron Profile: Measures iron levels to diagnose anaemia and other iron-related disorders.
  • Immunoglobulins Blood Test: Detects antibodies to diagnose infections, immune deficiencies, autoimmune disorders, and cancer.
  • Hemoglobinopathy Test: Evaluates abnormal structures or amounts of haemoglobin, identifying haemoglobin disorders.
  • Immune Phenotyping: Identifies cell lineages using antibodies to detect markers, aiding in the diagnosis of leukaemia, lymphoma, and blood cell cancers.
  • Cytogenetics and Molecular Studies: Tests blood and bone marrow samples for changes in chromosomes, diagnosing genetic diseases, conditions, or certain cancers.

At ILS Hospitals, our commitment to comprehensive haematological care ensures accurate diagnosis and tailored treatment plans for our patients, fostering healthier lives.

name: Hepatology
heading: Hepatology
content:
Hepatology

Hepatology is a specialized field of medicine focused on the study, diagnosis, and treatment of diseases affecting the liver, gallbladder, biliary tree, and pancreas. Given the liver’s critical role in digestion, metabolism, detoxification, and nutrient storage, maintaining its health is essential for overall well-being. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Hepatology is dedicated to providing advanced, comprehensive, and compassionate care for patients with liver-related conditions, supported by state-of-the-art technology and an experienced medical team.

Comprehensive Care for Liver and Related Disorders

Liver diseases can range from common conditions like fatty liver and hepatitis to more complex problems such as cirrhosis, portal hypertension, biliary disorders, and liver cancer. The Hepatology department at ILS Hospitals also addresses genetic and autoimmune liver diseases, as well as metabolic and toxin-induced liver damage. Additionally, the team manages gallbladder diseases, bile duct obstructions, and pancreatic disorders, ensuring complete hepatobiliary and pancreatic care.

Expert Medical Team

The department is staffed with highly trained hepatologists, gastroenterologists, endoscopists, radiologists, and liver surgeons who work together to offer a multidisciplinary approach. These specialists have extensive expertise in both medical and interventional treatments, ensuring patients receive individualized and evidence-based care for their specific condition.

Advanced Diagnostic Capabilities

Early detection is key to successful liver disease management. ILS Hospitals is equipped with cutting-edge diagnostic tools, including high-resolution ultrasound, CT scans, MRI, FibroScan, liver biopsy facilities, and advanced blood testing for liver function. These tools allow accurate assessment of liver health, detection of fibrosis or cirrhosis, and monitoring of treatment progress over time.

Treatment & Interventions

The Hepatology team provides a wide range of treatment options, from lifestyle and dietary guidance for early-stage liver disease to advanced medical therapies for hepatitis B and C, autoimmune liver conditions, and metabolic disorders. Interventional procedures, such as endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS), and minimally invasive surgeries, are performed for complex hepatobiliary cases. For advanced liver failure, the department works in collaboration with liver transplant centers to ensure continuity of care.

Management of Chronic Liver Disease

Chronic liver conditions like hepatitis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), and cirrhosis require long-term monitoring and specialized care. At ILS Hospitals, patients benefit from structured follow-up programs that include regular evaluations, medication adjustments, nutritional counseling, and lifestyle modifications to prevent disease progression.

Preventive Liver Care

Prevention plays a vital role in hepatology. The department emphasizes public awareness about safe lifestyle practices, vaccination against hepatitis viruses, and timely screening for individuals at higher risk, such as those with diabetes, obesity, or a history of alcohol abuse.

Patient-Centric Approach

At ILS Hospitals, the focus is on providing not only medical treatment but also emotional and psychological support to patients and their families. Educational counseling, dietary advice, and rehabilitation programs are integral parts of the care plan, ensuring patients are informed and actively involved in their recovery journey.

Liver diseases can be complex and life-threatening if not managed promptly and effectively. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Hepatology combines medical expertise, advanced diagnostics, and compassionate care to deliver the highest standard of treatment for all liver and hepatobiliary disorders. With a strong emphasis on prevention, early intervention, and patient education, the department strives to protect and restore liver health, helping patients lead healthier and more fulfilling lives.

Treatment & Interventions The Hepatology team provides a wide range of treatment options, from lifestyle and dietary guidance for early-stage liver disease to advanced medical therapies for hepatitis B and C, autoimmune liver conditions, and metabolic disorders. Interventional procedures, such as endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS), and minimally invasive surgeries, are performed for complex hepatobiliary cases. For advanced liver failure, the department works in collaboration with liver transplant centers to ensure continuity of care. Management of Chronic Liver Disease Chronic liver conditions like hepatitis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), and cirrhosis require long-term monitoring and specialized care. At ILS Hospitals, patients benefit from structured follow-up programs that include regular evaluations, medication adjustments, nutritional counseling, and lifestyle modifications to prevent disease progression. Preventive Liver Care Prevention plays a vital role in hepatology. The department emphasizes public awareness about safe lifestyle practices, vaccination against hepatitis viruses, and timely screening for individuals at higher risk, such as those with diabetes, obesity, or a history of alcohol abuse. Patient-Centric Approach At ILS Hospitals, the focus is on providing not only medical treatment but also emotional and psychological support to patients and their families. Educational counseling, dietary advice, and rehabilitation programs are integral parts of the care plan, ensuring patients are informed and actively involved in their recovery journey. Liver diseases can be complex and life-threatening if not managed promptly and effectively. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Hepatology combines medical expertise, advanced diagnostics, and compassionate care to deliver the highest standard of treatment for all liver and hepatobiliary disorders. With a strong emphasis on prevention, early intervention, and patient education, the department strives to protect and restore liver health, helping patients lead healthier and more fulfilling lives.

name: Nephrology
heading: Nephrology Department at ILS Hospitals
content:
Nephrology Department at ILS Hospitals

Comprehensive Kidney Care and Innovative Dialysis Services

At ILS Hospitals, our Nephrology Department is dedicated to understanding kidney diseases in-depth, including their development, progression, treatment, and prevention. Our mission is clear – to provide exceptional clinical care, conduct cutting-edge research, and offer specialized training programs. Our team consists of passionate individuals who are driven by their commitment to the advancement of kidney care.

Nephrology Services:

  • Dialysis Excellence: Our Dialysis Unit comprises a multidisciplinary team of nephrologists, nurses, social workers, dietitians, and technicians. We focus on delivering optimal outcomes for dialysis patients. Our commitment to innovation allows us to provide high-quality dialysis care that is both accessible and comfortable, with significantly improved results. Our Dialysis Unit features state-of-the-art volumetric-controlled hemodialysis machines, operated by highly skilled technical and nursing staff. Moreover, we boast one of the few units in West Bengal where regular endotoxin tests are performed. To enhance patient comfort during dialysis, each dialysis station is equipped with a sophisticated audio/visual system, allowing patients to watch TV programs of their choice.
  • Critical Care Nephrology: Our Center for Nephrology plays a pivotal role in intensive care by providing critical care nephrology services to ICU patients experiencing acute renal failure, volume imbalances, or electrolyte and acid-base disorders. We are equipped to dialyze critically ill patients without the need to transfer them to the primary Dialysis Unit.
  • Preoperative and Cardiovascular Kidney Support: Our Dialysis Center collaborates closely with other medical specialties to address patients’ kidney health before surgical procedures or cardiovascular interventions such as Coronary angiograms and angioplasties. This approach ensures the best possible outcomes. Our daily activities involve performing over 400 hemodialysis procedures, CAPD (Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis), 10-15 SLEDDs (Sustained Low-Efficiency Daily Dialysis), and 25-30 temporary/permanent vascular access placements each week.

Our Services Include:

  • Comprehensive diagnostic, treatment, and prevention services for chronic kidney disease in adults and children.
  • Acute Kidney Injury Management
  • Tailored treatments for conditions like polycystic kidney disease and kidney stones.
  • Treatment of nephritic syndrome and various glomerulonephritis conditions.
  • Round-the-clock regular hemodialysis.
  • Bedside hemodialysis for intensive care unit patients.
  • Sustained Low-Efficiency Daily Dialysis (SLEDD).
  • Dedicated dialysis machines and isolation rooms for HBsAg and HCV-positive patients.
  • Plasmapheresis services for renal, neurological, and other patients.
  • Peritoneal Dialysis – CAPD (Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis) and CCPD (Continuous Cyclic Peritoneal Dialysis) training programs for patients and their caregivers.
  • Percutaneous Renal Biopsy performed under Ultrasound guidance.
  • Renal Histopathology studies.
  • Management of essential and secondary hypertension.

At ILS Hospitals, we are committed to providing comprehensive, compassionate, and innovative kidney care to our patients. Our expert nephrologists and advanced facilities are here to ensure that you receive the best care possible for kidney-related conditions.

name: Neuro Surgery
heading: Neurosurgery
content:
Neurosurgery

Neurosurgery is a highly specialized branch of medicine focused on the diagnosis, surgical treatment, and rehabilitation of disorders affecting the brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nervous system. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Neurosurgery combines advanced surgical expertise with modern technology to offer comprehensive care for a wide range of neurological conditions. The department is committed to delivering precise, effective, and compassionate treatment to patients, ensuring the best possible outcomes.

Scope of Neurosurgical Services

The Neurosurgery team at ILS Hospitals handles complex cases involving brain tumors, spinal cord injuries, herniated discs, cerebrovascular disorders such as aneurysms and arteriovenous malformations, hydrocephalus, head injuries, and congenital malformations. They also address functional neurological disorders like epilepsy, movement disorders, and chronic pain syndromes. From emergency trauma surgeries to planned corrective procedures, the department offers both life-saving and quality-of-life-enhancing interventions.

Expert Team of Specialists

The department is staffed with experienced neurosurgeons, neuro-anesthetists, neuro-radiologists, and skilled nursing teams. These experts work collaboratively to ensure accurate diagnosis, meticulous surgical planning, and effective post-operative care. Many of the neurosurgeons at ILS Hospitals are trained in minimally invasive techniques, which allow for faster recovery, reduced scarring, and less discomfort for patients.

Advanced Technology and Facilities

ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art operating theatres designed for complex neurosurgical procedures. These include high-resolution neuro-navigation systems, intraoperative imaging, operating microscopes, and advanced endoscopic tools. Such technology enables precision during delicate surgeries, minimizing the risk of complications and improving patient safety.

Minimally Invasive and Endoscopic Neurosurgery

Whenever possible, the department adopts minimally invasive approaches for both brain and spine surgeries. Endoscopic neurosurgery allows surgeons to operate through small incisions or natural openings, reducing tissue damage and shortening hospital stays. These techniques are particularly beneficial for pituitary tumors, spinal decompression, and certain cerebrovascular procedures.

Comprehensive Spine Surgery

Spinal disorders are a major focus of the Neurosurgery department. The team performs a variety of procedures, including spinal fusion, laminectomy, discectomy, and correction of spinal deformities such as scoliosis. Advanced instrumentation and image-guided surgery ensure optimal alignment and stability, leading to better long-term results.

Emergency Neurosurgical Care

Neurosurgical emergencies such as traumatic brain injuries, intracranial hemorrhages, and acute spinal cord compression require rapid intervention. ILS Hospitals offers 24/7 emergency neurosurgery services, supported by modern intensive care units (ICUs) and round-the-clock diagnostic imaging, ensuring immediate and effective response in critical situations.

Rehabilitation and Follow-Up Care

Post-surgical recovery in neurosurgery often requires rehabilitation to restore mobility, cognitive functions, and overall quality of life. ILS Hospitals offers physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, and neuropsychological support as part of its integrated rehabilitation program. Regular follow-up visits and imaging help monitor progress and prevent recurrence of conditions.

Patient-Centric Approach

Every patient’s journey is guided by a compassionate and transparent approach. The team takes time to explain procedures, discuss treatment options, and address concerns, ensuring that patients and their families are fully informed and comfortable with the care plan.

At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Neurosurgery stands at the forefront of advanced brain and spine care. By blending surgical expertise, cutting-edge technology, and a patient-first philosophy, the hospital delivers world-class neurosurgical services close to home, helping patients overcome complex neurological challenges and reclaim their quality of life.

name: Neurology
content:
The Department of Neurology & Interventional Neurology at ILS Hospitals is dedicated to providing round-the-clock diagnostic and therapeutic neurology services based on evidence-backed protocols aligned with internationally accepted guidelines. Our 24/7 casualty services cater to the diagnosis and early management of neurological emergencies, including Status Epilepticus, Stroke, Neuromuscular Weakness, Encephalitis, Meningitis, and behaviour changes.

Specialized Departments:

Department of Neurology & Stroke:

  • Equipped with ICU facilities and bedside Electro Encephalogram (EEG) Monitoring.
  • Round-the-clock neurologists for diagnosis, treatment, and management.
  • State-of-the-art diagnostic imaging modalities, including MRI and CT Scan.

Services:

  • Comprehensive stroke care, including IV Thrombolysis and mechanical thrombectomy.
  • Diagnosis and management of Seizure Disorders and Refractory Epilepsies.
  • Neurophysiology unit offering EEG, EMG and NCV.
  • Management of Neuromuscular Disorders, Peripheral Neuropathies, Headaches, and Chronic Pains.
  • Neuro Rehabilitation, including Physiotherapy and Occupational Therapy.

Department of Interventional Neurology:

  • Minimally invasive solutions for complex brain diseases.
  • Specialists skilled in delicate and high-precision procedures.
  • Intra-arterial/intravenous route interventions for minimal trauma and fast recovery.
  • Focus on Comprehensive Stroke Management & Treatment.

Rehabilitation Services and Behavioural Sciences:

  • Committed to providing comprehensive rehabilitation services.
  • Integration of behavioural sciences for holistic patient care.

Why Choose ILS Hospitals’ Institute of Neurosciences?

  • Round-the-Clock Care: Our dedicated team ensures 24/7 care for neurology emergencies.
  • Advanced Technology: State-of-the-art diagnostic and infrastructure for precise interventions.
  • Comprehensive Services: From diagnostics to rehabilitation, we offer a continuum of neurological care.
  • Expert Specialists: Experienced neurologists and interventionists lead our team.

At ILS Hospitals, we are committed to delivering international-class, patient-centric neurological care. Our foundation rests on ethics and morality, ensuring that every patient receives the highest standard of care. Trust us for your neurological well-being.

mainEntity.name: What are the visiting hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visiting hours are as followed: Ward/Twin Sharing/Cabin/Suite: 9am - 10am | 5pm - 7pm ITU/ICU/CCU/NICU/HDU: 5pm - 6pm | 9am - 10am (Saltlake only)

mainEntity.name: Rules and guidelines for visitors

acceptedAnswer.text: Visitors must carry visitor pass. Only two persons are allowed during visiting hours at Ward/Twin Sharing/Cabin/Suite and only one person is allowed during visiting hours at ITU/ICU/CCU/NICU/HDU. Children are strictly not allowed in critical care areas.

mainEntity.name: Is outside food allowed into the hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outside medicines and foods are not allowed within hospital premises. Patient meals are served as per instruction of the doctor and dietician.

mainEntity.name: What is the mode of payment in your hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: The payment can be made by Cash / Credit Card / Debit Cards/ DD/ Wire Transfer / Cheque.

mainEntity.name: Is advance payment must for an emergency case?

acceptedAnswer.text: During emergency every minute is vital so the admission is done immediately without any advance deposit money and the patient is taken under medical observation.

mainEntity.name: Do you have any health check up packages?

acceptedAnswer.text: ILS Hospitals are equipped with the latest and accurate testing equipments, trained technicians and specialists providing an advance range of health check up and screening services. This Health Check up Packages covers a wide range of investigations like from basic standard set of blood tests to detailed physical examinations and consultation by experienced doctors and each package is tailored to suit the needs of an individual.

mainEntity.name: Do you have the facility of cashless treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Cashless facility is available for empanelled TPA's & insurance Companies.

mainEntity.name: Is Mediclaim policy accepted at your hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, empanelled TPA's & insurance Companies are accepted at the hospitals.

mainEntity.name: Does the hospital have 24×7 emergency care services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, 24 x 7 Emergency care service is available at the hospitals.

mainEntity.name: Is Dialysis facility available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Dialysis facility is available at ILS Hospitals Agartala and ILS Hospitals Dumdum.

mainEntity.name: How the bed charges are calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bed charges are calculated as per 24 hour basis from the time of admission.

mainEntity.name: Working hours of Admission and Billing section?

acceptedAnswer.text: Admission and Billing section functions 24x7.

mainEntity.name: What are the required documents for admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: The mainly required documents are Prescription of any previous treatment, Diagnostic test reports, Details of all medicine & dosages of the patient, Patient id proof, insurance or medical benefit card or proof.

name: Neurology (Interventional)
heading: ILS Hospitals: Advancing Neurological Care through Interventional Neurology
content:
ILS Hospitals: Advancing Neurological Care through Interventional Neurology

Interventional Neurology, a dynamic specialty at ILS Hospitals, seamlessly blends the expertise of neurology and interventional radiology. This innovative field employs cutting-edge imaging techniques and catheter-based procedures to diagnose and treat various neurological disorders. Our dedicated team of highly skilled interventional neurologists, coupled with state-of-the-art technology, is committed to providing exceptional care to our patients.

Conditions Treated by Interventional Neurology:

  • Stroke: Interventional neurology is instrumental in managing acute ischemic strokes. Our specialists deliver clot-busting medications directly to the blockage site or use mechanical devices to remove the clot, enhancing patient outcomes.
  • Aneurysms: Aneurysms, abnormal bulges in blood vessels, can be repaired using techniques like coiling and stenting, minimizing the risk of rupture and promoting better patient outcomes.
  • Arteriovenous Malformations (AVMs): Tangled connections between arteries and veins in the brain or spinal cord are treated by blocking or embolizing these abnormal blood vessels, reducing the risk of bleeding and alleviating associated symptoms.
  • Brain Tumors: Interventional neurology aids in the diagnosis and treatment of specific brain tumors. Techniques like embolization reduce blood flow to the tumor, making surgical removal safer and more effective.
  • Vascular Stenosis: Narrowing of blood vessels in the brain or neck is addressed through interventional procedures like angioplasty and stenting, restoring blood flow and preventing further complications.

Advanced Techniques and Technology:

Our commitment to providing the latest in interventional neurology is reflected in our state-of-the-art facilities. Equipped with advanced imaging technologies, including angiography and fluoroscopy, our specialists visualize and navigate the complex structures of the brain and spinal cord with exceptional precision.

Innovative techniques and tools such as micro catheters and embolic materials are employed to deliver targeted treatments while minimizing damage to surrounding healthy tissues. These minimally invasive approaches translate to shorter hospital stays, faster recovery times, and improved patient outcomes.

Comprehensive Care and Patient-Centered Approach:

Our multidisciplinary team collaborates to create personalized treatment plans tailored to each patient’s specific needs. We prioritize open communication and active involvement of patients and their families throughout the treatment process, ensuring a supportive and patient-centric approach.

Take the first step towards improved neurological health today. Contact us to schedule an appointment with one of our experienced interventional neurologists at ILS Hospitals.

name: Obstetrics & Gynaecology
heading: Comprehensive Women’s Healthcare at ILS Hospitals: Nurturing Every Phase of Womanhood
content:
Comprehensive Women’s Healthcare at ILS Hospitals: Nurturing Every Phase of Womanhood

At ILS Hospitals, we understand the unique and intricate nature of women’s health. Our Obstetrics and Gynaecology departments are dedicated to providing comprehensive care that spans from adolescence to menopause and beyond. Let’s delve into the realms of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, where our commitment to excellence meets the diverse needs of every woman.

Obstetrics: Ensuring a Smooth Journey to Motherhood

Obstetrics is the specialized branch of medicine that focuses on the well-being of pregnant women, the unborn child, and the entire spectrum of childbirth. Our skilled obstetricians are dedicated to ensuring a safe and complication-free journey for both mother and child. Some of the aspects covered by our Obstetrics department include:

  • High-Risk Pregnancies: Addressing complexities such as Pre-eclampsia, Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), and Gestational Hypertension to safeguard both maternal and foetal health.
  • Foetal Distress Management: Expertly handling situations where the well-being of the baby is compromised due to compression or other factors.
  • Screening during Pregnancy: Offering thorough screening for medical conditions, high blood pressure, infections, and chromosomal abnormalities to ensure early detection and appropriate management.
  • Postpartum Care: Managing postpartum complications, both medical and psychological, with the utmost care and expertise.

Our obstetricians are well-versed in handling a range of difficulties that may arise during childbirth, from extra-uterine pregnancies to postpartum haemorrhage. Whether it’s a routine delivery or a planned/emergency caesarean section, our obstetrics team is equipped to navigate the intricate course of childbirth with skill and compassion.

Experience the joy of motherhood with our unique ‘Bundle of Joy’ program, offering prenatal and postnatal classes, infant care, and breastfeeding support. Our state-of-the-art technology, including Wireless CTG for precise monitoring, ensures the well-being of both mother and baby.

Gynaecology: Elevating Women’s Reproductive Health

Gynaecology at ILS Hospitals goes beyond addressing reproductive organs’ concerns; it encompasses a woman’s entire reproductive journey, from adolescence through menopause and beyond. Our services include:

  • Preventive Care: Offering crucial preventive measures such as pap smears, mammography, and comprehensive screenings to ensure early detection of potential issues.
  • Adolescent Health: Specialized care for young women dealing with pre-ovarian puberty, amenorrhea, and other adolescent-related challenges.
  • Reproductive Health: Addressing concerns related to infertility, contraception, menstrual irregularities, and peri-menopausal issues.
  • Post-Menopausal Conditions: Expert management of conditions like prolapse, incontinence, and post-menopausal bleeding.
  • Screening and Treatment of Gynaecological Malignancies: Early detection and comprehensive treatment of gynaecological cancers for the best possible outcomes.

Our gynaecologists, most of whom are also obstetricians, provide holistic care for women. Beyond annual check-ups, they assist with pain, discomfort, infections, infertility, and contraception. Gynaecology is about diagnosing and treating reproductive system diseases, including cancers, and addressing pelvic organ prolapse.

At ILS Hospitals the department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology stands as a beacon of exceptional maternity care. Our broad spectrum of services includes adolescent health programs, preconception counselling, reproductive medicine, prenatal classes, preventive health programs, high-risk pregnancy care, contraceptive medicine, IVF programs, menopausal care, and assisted conception and infertility solutions.

name: Oncology (Surgical)
heading: Surgical Oncology at ILS Hospitals
content:
Surgical Oncology at ILS Hospitals

Surgical oncology is a specialized branch of surgery that involves the removal of cancerous tissues or tumors from the body. It plays a pivotal role in treating many types of cancer, either as a standalone treatment or in combination with other therapies like chemotherapy, radiation therapy, or immunotherapy. The main aim is to remove as much of the tumor as possible, reduce the risk of cancer recurrence, and preserve the health of surrounding tissues and organs.

Types of Surgical Procedures in Oncology at ILS Hospital

  • Tumor Removal Surgery: The most common surgical procedure for cancer treatment is the removal of the primary tumor. Depending on the type and location of the cancer, our surgeons work to remove the tumor with precision while ensuring minimal damage to surrounding healthy tissue.
  • Lymph Node Dissection: In some cases, cancer may spread to nearby lymph nodes. Lymph node dissection, or removal, may be necessary to ensure that cancer has not spread beyond the primary site. Our surgical team carefully removes affected lymph nodes to prevent further spread of cancer.
  • Minimally Invasive Surgery: Using advanced techniques such as laparoscopy or robotic surgery, we can perform tumor removal with smaller incisions. These techniques result in less pain, shorter recovery times, and reduced scarring, allowing patients to return to their normal lives faster.
  • Reconstructive Surgery: In cases where the cancer affects areas like the breast, head, or neck, reconstructive surgery may be necessary to restore the function and appearance of the affected areas after tumor removal. Our expert surgeons work to ensure both functional and aesthetic outcomes for the patient.
  • Palliative Surgery: For advanced cancer cases, where curing the cancer is not possible, palliative surgery may be performed to alleviate symptoms, such as obstruction, bleeding, or pain. This improves the patient’s quality of life and comfort.

PET CT Scan: Advanced Imaging for Precision Diagnosis

Perfusion Computed Tomography (PET) CT scan is a cutting-edge imaging technique used to assess blood flow in tissues, especially the brain. It helps in detecting conditions like strokes, tumors, and blood circulation issues. This non-invasive scan delivers real-time, detailed images, enabling doctors to evaluate tissue health and plan accurate treatments.

PET CT scans are vital in emergency situations, providing rapid and reliable results for quick medical intervention. They are especially beneficial in stroke diagnosis, helping identify the affected areas and guiding targeted therapies. With advanced technology and skilled radiologists, PET CT scans ensure accurate diagnostics and better patient outcomes.

Why Choose Surgical Oncology at ILS Hospital?

  • Expert Surgical Team: Our surgical oncologists are highly trained in the latest techniques and have extensive experience in treating a variety of cancers. They work closely with other specialists, including medical oncologists and radiation oncologists, to create a personalized treatment plan for each patient.
  • Advanced Technology: ILS Hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art technology, including robotic surgical systems, laparoscopic tools, and imaging technologies, ensuring precise and effective surgical interventions.
  • Comprehensive Care: Beyond surgery, we offer a complete range of cancer care services, including pre-surgical consultations, post-operative care, rehabilitation, and psychological support. We believe in treating the whole person, not just the disease.

At ILS Hospital, our goal is to provide patients with the highest quality of surgical care, while ensuring their comfort, safety, and long-term well-being. Our skilled surgical oncologists are here to guide you through every step of your cancer treatment journey, delivering the best possible outcomes with compassion and expertise.

name: Oncology (Medical)
heading: Medical Oncology at ILS Hospitals
content:
Medical Oncology at ILS Hospitals

Medical oncology is a branch of medicine that deals with the diagnosis, treatment, and management of cancer using chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, and other medications. Medical oncologists play a central role in cancer care, coordinating treatments to ensure the best possible outcome for each patient. Their primary goal is to treat cancer using drugs that target cancer cells, while also focusing on managing side effects and improving the patient’s quality of life.

Treatments Offered by Medical Oncology at ILS Hospital

  • Chemotherapy: Chemotherapy uses powerful drugs to kill or slow the growth of cancer cells. At ILS Hospital, our medical oncologists carefully select chemotherapy regimens based on the type of cancer and the individual’s health. We also provide supportive care to help manage the side effects of chemotherapy, ensuring a more comfortable experience.
  • Targeted Therapy: This innovative treatment focuses on specific molecular targets that contribute to cancer growth. Targeted therapies are less harmful to healthy cells and often have fewer side effects compared to traditional chemotherapy. Our oncologists offer targeted therapy as part of a personalized treatment plan.
  • Immunotherapy: Immunotherapy works by stimulating the body’s immune system to recognize and attack cancer cells. It has shown promising results in treating certain types of cancers, such as melanoma, lung cancer, and lymphomas. At ILS Hospital, we provide access to the latest immunotherapies, offering new hope for many patients.
  • Hormone Therapy: Certain cancers, like breast and prostate cancer, are hormone-sensitive. Hormone therapy works by blocking the hormones that fuel these cancers. Our specialists carefully tailor hormone treatments to suit the specific needs of each patient.
  • Palliative and Supportive Care: Beyond direct cancer treatment, we offer palliative care to help manage symptoms, pain, and other physical and emotional challenges that patients may face during treatment. Our holistic approach ensures that patients receive the necessary emotional, nutritional, and psychological support.

PET CT Scan: Advanced Imaging for Precision Diagnosis

Perfusion Computed Tomography (PET) CT scan is a cutting-edge imaging technique used to assess blood flow in tissues, especially the brain. It helps in detecting conditions like strokes, tumors, and blood circulation issues. This non-invasive scan delivers real-time, detailed images, enabling doctors to evaluate tissue health and plan accurate treatments.

PET CT scans are vital in emergency situations, providing rapid and reliable results for quick medical intervention. They are especially beneficial in stroke diagnosis, helping identify the affected areas and guiding targeted therapies. With advanced technology and skilled radiologists, PET CT scans ensure accurate diagnostics and better patient outcomes.

Why Choose ILS Hospital for Medical Oncology?

  • Expert Oncology Team: ILS Hospital’s medical oncologists are highly trained, experienced, and committed to providing the most advanced cancer care available. They work with a multidisciplinary team of specialists to design personalized treatment plans.
  • Advanced Treatment Options: We utilize the latest research and state-of-the-art technology to provide the most effective cancer treatments, ensuring the best possible outcomes for our patients.
  • Patient-Centered Care: At ILS Hospital, we focus on the well-being of our patients, offering individualized care that supports both their medical needs and emotional health. From diagnosis to recovery, we are with our patients every step of the way.

ILS Hospital’s Medical Oncology Department is committed to delivering the highest standard of care, helping patients fight cancer with dignity, compassion, and expertise.

mainEntity.name: What are the visiting hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visiting hours are as followed: Ward/Twin Sharing/Cabin/Suite: 9am - 10am | 5pm - 7pm ITU/ICU/CCU/NICU/HDU: 5pm - 6pm | 9am - 10am (Saltlake only)

mainEntity.name: Rules and guidelines for visitors

acceptedAnswer.text: Visitors must carry visitor pass. Only two persons are allowed during visiting hours at Ward/Twin Sharing/Cabin/Suite and only one person is allowed during visiting hours at ITU/ICU/CCU/NICU/HDU. Children are strictly not allowed in critical care areas.

mainEntity.name: Is outside food allowed into the hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outside medicines and foods are not allowed within hospital premises. Patient meals are served as per instruction of the doctor and dietician.

mainEntity.name: What is the mode of payment in your hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: The payment can be made by Cash / Credit Card / Debit Cards/ DD/ Wire Transfer / Cheque.

mainEntity.name: Is advance payment must for an emergency case?

acceptedAnswer.text: During emergency every minute is vital so the admission is done immediately without any advance deposit money and the patient is taken under medical observation.

mainEntity.name: Do you have any health check up packages?

acceptedAnswer.text: ILS Hospitals are equipped with the latest and accurate testing equipments, trained technicians and specialists providing an advance range of health check up and screening services. This Health Check up Packages covers a wide range of investigations like from basic standard set of blood tests to detailed physical examinations and consultation by experienced doctors and each package is tailored to suit the needs of an individual.

mainEntity.name: Do you have the facility of cashless treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Cashless facility is available for empanelled TPA's & insurance Companies.

mainEntity.name: Is Mediclaim policy accepted at your hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, empanelled TPA's & insurance Companies are accepted at the hospitals.

mainEntity.name: Does the hospital have 24×7 emergency care services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, 24 x 7 Emergency care service is available at the hospitals.

mainEntity.name: Is Dialysis facility available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Dialysis facility is available at ILS Hospitals Agartala and ILS Hospitals Dumdum.

mainEntity.name: How the bed charges are calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bed charges are calculated as per 24 hour basis from the time of admission.

mainEntity.name: Working hours of Admission and Billing section?

acceptedAnswer.text: Admission and Billing section functions 24x7.

mainEntity.name: What are the required documents for admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: The mainly required documents are Prescription of any previous treatment, Diagnostic test reports, Details of all medicine & dosages of the patient, Patient id proof, insurance or medical benefit card or proof.
