name: Opthalmology
heading: Comprehensive Eye Care at ILS Hospitals: Nurturing Vision, Ensuring Clarity
content:
Comprehensive Eye Care at ILS Hospitals: Nurturing Vision, Ensuring Clarity

At ILS Hospitals, we are dedicated to delivering cutting-edge eye care and specializing in advanced eye surgeries in India. Our commitment to excellence is reflected in our pioneering technology and highly experienced team of doctors, all striving for the swift and optimal recovery of our patients.

Surgical and Non-Surgical Expertise:

Whether it’s surgical or non-surgical treatment options, ILS Hospitals offers the best in eye care at our state-of-the-art facility. We take pride in having assisted numerous individuals in realizing their dreams of clear vision.

Eye Disorders and Diseases:

Several eye diseases can significantly impact vision, and at ILS Hospitals, we address a range of conditions, including:

  • Cataract:Characterized by the formation of dense and cloudy areas in one or both eyes, cataracts can impede clear vision. Symptoms include clouded vision, sensitivity to glare, halos around lights, double vision, and faded colors. ILS Hospitals provides advanced cataract treatments such as Phacoemulsification, MICS, and FLACS.
  • Glaucoma:A potentially vision-threatening disease that damages the optic nerve, glaucoma may lead to permanent vision loss if untreated. Often asymptomatic in its early stages, regular eye checkups are crucial, especially after the age of 40. ILS Hospitals diagnoses glaucoma using advanced equipment like OCT, Perimetry, and Pachymetry, offering treatment options including medications and advanced surgery.
  • Conjunctivitis (Pink Eye):Caused by bacteria or viruses, conjunctivitis results in inflammation of the inner eyelid and outer membrane of the eyeball. Symptoms include redness, irritation, tearing, and discharge. ILS Hospitals provides effective eye treatments for conjunctivitis, tailored to the patient’s overall health.
  • Squint:Squint, or misalignment of the eyes, can result from nerve injury or dysfunction in eye muscles. ILS Hospitals offers treatments such as lasers and advanced surgeries to correct squint conditions.
  • Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD):AMD blurs central vision, affecting detailed tasks like reading and driving. Over time, it can lead to blank spots in central vision. ILS Hospitals conducts diagnoses with OCT and FFA and provides facilities for intravitreal injections.
  • Refractive Error:A common eye problem, refractive errors can be corrected through LASIK surgery, offering a spectacle-free vision.
  • Diabetic Retinopathy:Resulting from diabetes, diabetic retinopathy damages the retina. ILS Hospitals diagnoses this condition with FFA and OCT, offering laser treatments for effective management.

Early Diagnosis, Timely Treatment:

If individuals experience vision issues, consulting ILS Hospitals for a comprehensive eye diagnosis is crucial. Early treatment is the key to maintaining healthy vision and preventing further complications.

State-of-the-Art Treatments at ILS Hospitals:

Our eye care services encompass Glaucoma Diagnostic Surgery, Eye Ultrasound, Lasers, Squint Eye Surgery, Cornea Diagnostic & Surgery, Retina and Vitreous Diagnostics, low vision aids and comprehensive eye examinations. ILS Hospitals stands as a beacon of excellence, ensuring the utmost care for your vision. Schedule a consultation with our expert ophthalmologists to embark on a journey to clearer, healthier eyes at ILS Hospitals. Your vision is our priority.

name: Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery
heading: Types of Implantology:
content:
Maxillofacial surgery is a specialized field that addresses various diseases, injuries, and defects affecting the face, jaw, and mouth. This surgical discipline aims to reduce facial pain, restore function, and correct deformities. Maxillofacial surgeons, highly trained specialists, are responsible for diagnosing and treating oral issues related to the jaw bones, lips, and palate.

Types of Maxillofacial Surgery:

  • Wisdom Tooth Removal: Surgical extraction of one or more wisdom teeth to alleviate issues caused by insufficient space for proper growth.
  • Tooth Extraction: Surgical removal of teeth affected by decay, infection, or crowding, either through a simple or more complex procedure.
  • Apicoectomy: A dental procedure to remove inflamed gum tissue and the tooth root while preserving the top of the tooth, addressing issues unresolved by root canal surgery.
  • Temporomandibular Joint Surgery: Addresses temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disorders, which can cause headaches, jaw pain, earaches, and difficulty in mouth movement.
  • Cleft Palate or Lip Surgery: Corrective surgery for infants born with a cleft palate, improving their ability to eat and speak.
  • Jaw Reconstruction/Reconstructive Surgery: Orthognathic surgery to correct irregular jaw bones, realign jaw bones and teeth, and address issues such as difficulty in chewing or swallowing.

Types of Implantology:

Implantology, a dental specialty, focuses on dental implants, artificial tooth roots typically made of titanium. Various implant techniques include:

  • Bone Augmentation: Restores or regenerates jawbone when inadequate to support implants, commonly performed when there’s insufficient bone.
  • Ridge Expansion: Addresses a narrow jaw by dividing the ridge bone into inner and outer segments, stretching them apart, and filling the space with bone graft.
  • Sinus Lift: Adds bone below the sinus when natural bone deteriorates, ensuring proper support for dental implants.
  • Endosteal Implants: Titanium implants surgically placed in the jawbone to hold artificial teeth.
  • Subperiosteal Implants: Utilized when a person lacks healthy jawbones to support dental implants, placed under the gum and around the jawbone.

Symptoms Indicating Maxillofacial Issues:

Several symptoms may suggest facial, jaw, or mouth problems that necessitate maxillofacial surgery:

  • Changes in facial appearance
  • Deformities or abnormalities in facial bones
  • Double vision
  • Missing teeth
  • Swelling and bruising around the face
  • Bleeding or pus from the gums
  • Facial or oral trauma
  • Severe tooth pain or sores
  • Difficulty in jaw movement or pain in jaw joints and muscles

When to See a Maxillofacial Surgeon:

A visit to a maxillofacial surgeon is recommended for individuals experiencing severe pain, abnormal jaw functioning, bone loss in the jaw, missing or broken teeth, oral diseases, extensive tooth decay, gum disease, impacted teeth, or benign oral pathology.

Diseases Treated by Maxillofacial Surgeons:

Maxillofacial surgeons address a range of conditions, including dental implants, misaligned jaws, head and neck cancer, oral reconstructive surgery, cysts, cleft lip and palate, TMJ disorders, and facial trauma involving jaw and facial bones.

Diagnostic Procedures:

Diagnostic procedures include physical examinations, X-rays for identifying tumours, infections, or changes in bone structure, MRIs for evaluating fractures and TMJ disorders, and oral biopsies to examine tissues for inflammatory changes or signs of cancer.

In summary, maxillofacial surgery and implantology play crucial roles in correcting and treating various facial and oral conditions, enhancing both function and aesthetics. Seeking the expertise of a maxillofacial surgeon is crucial when faced with symptoms or conditions requiring specialized care.

name: Orthopaedics & Joint Replacement
content:
Welcome to ILS Hospitals, home to the most comprehensive orthopaedic care and cutting-edge solutions in the field of musculoskeletal health. We take immense pride in being recognized as a pioneer in orthopaedic healthcare in India. Our unwavering commitment to excellence extends across a diverse spectrum of specialties, encompassing Sports Medicine, Paediatric Orthopedic Services, Arthritis Diagnosis, Treatment, and Pain Management. At ILS Hospitals, we are on a mission to deliver superlative patient care, underpinned by professional expertise, early mobilization, and a relentless dedication to elevating the standards of orthopedic treatment in Kolkata.

Our Specialized Procedures Encompass:

  • Computer Assisted Joint Replacement Surgery: Harnessing cutting-edge technology for precision in joint replacement surgery.
  • Arthroscopic Surgery: Employing minimally invasive techniques to address a variety of joint conditions.
  • Traumatic Orthopedic Surgery: Offering specialized care for complex orthopedic traumas.
  • Hand, Shoulder & Elbow Surgery: Focusing on intricate upper extremity orthopedic conditions.
  • Spine Surgery: Demonstrating expertise in spinal conditions and surgical interventions.
  • Articular Surface Replacement Hip Surgery: Employing state-of-the-art techniques in hip surgery.
  • Foot & Ankle Surgery: Catering to an extensive array of foot and ankle disorders.
  • Total Knee & Hip Replacement Surgery: Restoring mobility and alleviating pain through advanced surgical procedures.

Conditions and Treatments We Address:

  • Disc Replacement Surgery: If you’ve been enduring persistent lower back pain for at least six months without relief from medication, disc replacement surgery may offer a solution. This procedure involves replacing the problematic disc with a prosthetic implant, aiming to restore normal function.
  • Total Knee Replacement Surgery: Severe knee damage caused by arthritis or injury can severely impede everyday activities. When non-surgical treatments prove ineffective, total knee replacement surgery provides a safe solution, relieving pain, correcting leg deformities, and facilitating a return to normal life.
  • Joint Replacement Surgery: Joint pain and disability resulting from various conditions can significantly affect your quality of life. Joint replacement surgery, performed on knees, hips, wrists, ankles, elbows, and shoulders, can provide relief when non-surgical treatments fall short.
  • Hip Replacement Surgery: Hip pain can make even simple activities uncomfortable. Total hip replacement surgery is designed to alleviate pain, enhance function by replacing the damaged femoral head with a prosthetic implant, and restore mobility.
  • Arthritis: Arthritis, characterized by inflammatory joint disorders, can lead to pain, swelling, stiffness, and reduced mobility. When non-surgical approaches fail to relieve the pain, our orthopedic experts step in to provide appropriate solutions.
  • Osteoporosis: Osteoporosis weakens bones, making them susceptible to fractures. This condition often advances without noticeable symptoms. At the best Orthopedic Hospital in India, we offer timely treatments, including exercise, supplements, and medication to enhance bone density.
  • Spondylitis: Ankylosing Spondylitis, an inflammatory condition affecting vertebral joints, can impact posture and mobility. We offer expert care, including spinal and stretching exercises, alongside various medications.
  • Spinal Fractures and Paralysis: Spinal fractures or instability can lead to abnormal movement between vertebrae, resulting in nerve and spinal cord damage. Our adept orthopedic team conducts thorough diagnostics and offers solutions for optimal outcomes.

At ILS Hospitals, we are unwavering in our commitment to providing world-class orthopedic care. With our experienced orthopedic surgeons and state-of-the-art facilities, you can trust us to offer the highest standard of care for your orthopedic conditions. Your journey toward renewed mobility and a pain-free life commences here.

name: Paediatric Surgery
heading: ILS Hospitals: Pioneering Paediatric Surgery for Young Lives
content:
ILS Hospitals: Pioneering Paediatric Surgery for Young Lives

At ILS Hospitals, our Paediatric Surgery department is committed to providing specialized surgical care for foetuses, infants, and children up to 18 years of age. Our skilled paediatric surgeons play a crucial role in developing optimal treatment plans, conducting preoperative examinations, and ensuring comprehensive post-surgical care. Collaborating closely with guardians and parents, our paediatric surgeons provide instructions, counselling, and necessary referrals to support groups or other professionals, contributing to the holistic well-being of the child.

Areas of Expertise in Paediatric Surgery:

  • Neonatal Surgery: Focused on surgical procedures for newborns, addressing congenital abnormalities that may impact normal growth.
  • Trauma and Injury Surgery: Specialized in addressing injuries resulting from accidents or violence, offering emergency care for children in traumatic situations.

When to Consult a Paediatric Surgeon:

You may need to seek the expertise of a paediatric surgeon when:

  • Surgery is Essential for Pain Management
  • Corrective Surgery is Needed for Congenital Conditions
  • Improvement of Child’s Mobility Requires Surgery
  • Complications Arise After Previous Surgery (e.g., bleeding, infections)
  • Presence of Tumours in Children
  • Child Suffers Severe Injuries Requiring Surgery
  • Organ Transplantation is Necessary

Conditions Treated by Paediatric Surgeons:

  • Congenital Disorders: Treatment of congenital disabilities like imperforate anus, gastroschisis, and Hirschsprung’s disease.
  • Pectus Excavatum: Surgical correction of the sunken chest using minimally invasive procedures.
  • Vascular Malformations: Addressing abnormalities in lymphatic or blood vessels through surgery.
  • Appendectomy: Surgical correction of the sunken chest using minimally invasive procedures.
  • Bowed Chest: Corrective surgery for disproportionate rib and breast bone growth.
  • Gallbladder Surgery: Removal of the gallbladder harboring stones causing pain.
  • Biliary Atresia: Biliary Atresia: Surgical correction for bile ducts unable to empty properly.
  • Imperforate Anus: Corrective surgery for incorrectly placed anus openings.
  • Reproductive Conditions:Corrective surgery for children born with reproductive conditions

Diagnostic Procedures by Paediatric Surgeons:

  • Pulse Oximetry: Measuring oxygen levels in the blood to identify congenital heart diseases.
  • X-rays: Imaging tests for clear visuals of bones and internal structures.
  • Angiogram: Studying the shape and size of the child’s blood vessels.
  • Ultrasound: Using sound waves for imaging internal organs.
  • Blood and Urine Tests: Gathering information on general health, infections, organ function, and genetic conditions.
  • Biopsy: Conducting biopsies for conditions like cancer, infection, and inflammation.
  • Endoscopy: Detecting acid reflux, ulcers, and infections through minimally invasive procedures.
  • CT and MRI Scans: Imaging tests for a comprehensive view of the child’s internal organs.

At ILS Hospitals, our dedicated team of paediatric surgeons ensures that children receive specialized care, aiming for optimal outcomes and improved quality of life.

name: Paediatrics
heading: ILS Hospitals: Elevating Child Healthcare with Expert Paediatric Services
content:
ILS Hospitals: Elevating Child Healthcare with Expert Paediatric Services

At ILS Hospitals, we prioritize the well-being of the youngest members of your family through our comprehensive Paediatrics department. Paediatrics is a specialized branch of medicine dedicated to the healthcare of infants, children, and adolescents. Our paediatricians are skilled generalists, equipped to address a broad spectrum of diseases and illnesses affecting the younger population.

Services Provided by Paediatricians:

Our dedicated paediatricians go beyond traditional medical care, offering a range of essential services to ensure the optimal health and development of your child. These services include:

  • Physical Exams: Thorough physical examinations are conducted to monitor your child’s overall health.
  • Vaccinations: We provide essential vaccinations to safeguard your child against preventable diseases.
  • Milestone Monitoring: Ensuring that your child meets growth, behavioural, and skill-related milestones is a crucial aspect of our care.
  • Diagnosis and Treatment: From common infections to complex health issues, our paediatricians diagnose and treat a wide array of conditions.
  • Health Information: We offer valuable information regarding your child’s health, nutrition, safety, and fitness needs.
  • Developmental Guidance: Answering questions about your child’s development and growth is an integral part of our paediatric care.
  • Specialist Referrals: If specialized care is required, our paediatricians make referrals to experts, ensuring comprehensive healthcare.

About Paediatricians:

Paediatricians at ILS Hospitals are highly trained medical experts specializing in the unique healthcare needs of infants, children, and teenagers. Their extensive knowledge encompasses various ailments impacting children’s health, behaviour, welfare, and education. Some paediatricians undergo general training, while others specialize in specific areas such as neonatology (new-born care), cardiology (heart diseases), and development and behaviour.

Why Choose a Paediatrician? Opting for a paediatrician over a family doctor is advantageous for several reasons:

  • Specialized Training: Paediatricians undergo specialized training in children’s health, making them well-equipped to address paediatric healthcare needs.
  • Experience with Childhood Illnesses: Focused solely on children in their practice, paediatricians have extensive experience in recognizing and treating childhood illnesses.
  • Specialized Care: In cases of premature birth or health conditions requiring close monitoring, paediatricians offer more specialized and targeted care compared to family doctors.

Our institute stands as one of the premier childcare hospitals in the country, prioritizing the needs of children. Our state-of-the-art Neonatal Intensive Care Units (NICU) and Paediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU) cater to critically ill children. The expertise of our General Paediatrics team extends to treating new-born problems, adolescent issues, and late-night fevers.

At ILS Hospitals, we are your one-stop destination for childcare services, offering paediatric surgical, paediatric, and immunization services for children up to 16 years. Our team comprises experienced paediatricians and paediatric surgeons specializing in various fields, developmental specialists, and adolescent paediatrics. Trust us for comprehensive and compassionate paediatric care—where the health and happiness of your child always come first.

The expertise of our General Paediatrics team extends to treating new-born problems, adolescent issues, and late-night fevers. At ILS Hospitals, we are your one-stop destination for childcare services, offering paediatric surgical, paediatric, and immunization services for children up to 16 years. Our team comprises experienced paediatricians and paediatric surgeons specializing in various fields, developmental specialists, and adolescent paediatrics. Trust us for comprehensive and compassionate paediatric care—where the health and happiness of your child always come first.

name: Pain Management
content:
At ILS Hospitals, our Comprehensive Pain Management Services address a wide range of chronic pain issues with a holistic and personalized approach. Our team of expert Pain Consultants collaborates with Physiotherapists, Psychologists, Occupational Therapists and Dieticians to provide integrated care, maximizing health gains for each individual.

Our non-surgical alternatives emphasize a multidisciplinary strategy, offering customized and coordinated care to meet the unique needs of our patients.

Services provided by our Pain Management experts:

We regularly assist patients dealing with chronic pain conditions, including but not limited to:

  • Low back pain
  • Sciatica
  • Neck and cervical pain
  • Joint pain (hip, knee, shoulder)
  • Musculoskeletal problems (tennis elbow, plantar fasciitis, trochanteric bursitis)
  • Neuropathic pain (diabetic neuropathy, post herpetic neuralgia)
  • Persistent post-surgical pain
  • Headaches
  • Cancer pain
  • Abdominal and pelvic pain
  • Various other chronic pain conditions

Our comprehensive services encompass detailed pain assessments, in-clinic diagnostic ultrasound scans, and multidisciplinary assessments with physiotherapy and psychology specialists. We provide interventions such as ultrasound and fluoroscopy-guided injections, intravenous infusions, radiofrequency treatment, closely supervised physiotherapy and rehabilitation, and psychology input, including Cognitive Behavioural Therapy. Complementary therapies like acupuncture and meditation are also offered, with personalized pain management plans tailored to the principles of our Pain Management Programme.

Receive Support from our Experienced Team:

Our seasoned team is dedicated to offering help, advice, and support in implementing lifestyle modifications aimed at sustaining the benefits of our pain management interventions. We collaborate with you not only to alleviate pain but also to minimize its impact on your daily life. Our goal is to customize therapies based on your specific requirements, ultimately enhancing your overall quality of life.

name: Physiotherapy
heading: ILS Hospitals: Transforming Lives Through Advanced Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Services
content:
ILS Hospitals: Transforming Lives Through Advanced Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Services

The Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Department at ILS Hospitals stands as a leading provider of tertiary-level rehabilitation services across North India, with prominent locations in Delhi NCR (Saket, Patparganj, Vaishali, Shalimar Bagh, Panchsheel Park, Greater Noida, Gurgaon, and Noida) and Dehradun. Designed to deliver top-notch patient care, this department plays a vital role in restoring independence to individuals after debilitating diseases or traumatic injuries. Our specialists collaborate with patients to minimize the physical and cognitive effects of disabilities, empowering them to achieve their maximum potential.

Benefits of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitative Care:

Depending on an individual’s medical and emotional condition, patients can experience various benefits from physiotherapy and rehabilitative care, including:

  • Return to Work: Restoration of functional abilities supports a smooth return to the workforce.
  • Independent Living Skills: Development of skills crucial for independent living, reducing the need for long-term home care.
  • Reduced Hospitalization: Shortened or less frequent hospital stays contribute to enhanced recovery.

Expertise:

The Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Department at ILS Hospitals boasts a team of highly skilled and experienced healthcare professionals. This includes physiotherapists, occupational therapists, orthopaedic therapists, sports therapists, paediatric therapists, cardiologists, neurologists, pulmonologists, rehabilitation assistants, and specialized nurses. Collaborating seamlessly, this team delivers world-class healthcare services, encompassing both inpatient and outpatient programs.

State-of-the-Art Infrastructure: Equipped with modern infrastructure, our department utilizes advanced diagnostic and therapeutic technologies. Key components include:

  • Electrotherapy
  • Heat therapy/cryotherapy
  • Microwave diathermy
  • Hi-power laser
  • Short wave diathermy
  • Electromyography (EMG)/Biofeedback
  • Electrical Modalities (TENS, ultrasound, laser, EMS)
  • Balance board
  • Various therapeutic machines
  • Latest exercise equipment
  • Vital Stim for dysphagia management
  • Transcutaneous neuromuscular electrical stimulation (TNMES)

Inpatient Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation:

Our state-of-the-art inpatient facility ensures optimal care for various conditions, including:

  • Cancer rehabilitation
  • Paediatric rehabilitation
  • Spine rehabilitation
  • Stroke rehabilitation
  • Traumatic brain injury
  • Pulmonary rehabilitation
  • Pain rehabilitation
  • Cardiovascular rehabilitation
  • Orthopaedic rehabilitation

Outpatient Services:

Our comprehensive outpatient services cater to a range of conditions, including:

  • Amputee rehabilitation
  • Arthritis rehabilitation
  • Dysphagia rehabilitation
  • Hand clinic
  • Lymphedema clinic
  • Osteoporosis rehabilitation
  • Paediatric rehabilitation
  • Spinal cord injury
  • Spine clinic
  • Sports injury rehabilitation
  • Stroke rehabilitation
  • Traumatic brain injury rehabilitation
  • Vestibular rehabilitation
  • Vascular/wound care centre
  • Back to work rehabilitation
  • Pulmonary rehabilitation
  • Fibromyalgia treatment centre
  • Manual therapy
  • Incontinence clinic

Holistic Approach:

Our Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Department serves as a one-stop destination for various physiotherapy and rehabilitative treatments. A thorough assessment by a physiotherapist or occupational therapist, considering health history, pain patterns, movement, strength, reflexes, sensation, and cardio-respiratory status, forms the basis for personalized treatment plans. The department offers services such as:

  • Cardiopulmonary Rehabilitation: A specialized program aiding patients with cardiac conditions in achieving optimal physical function.
  • Geriatric Care (Prevention of Falls): Tailored programs for seniors, focusing on regaining independence, enhancing safety, and reducing the risk of falls.
  • Dysphagia Management: Expertise in treating swallowing problems, especially post-stroke dysphagia, utilizing advanced therapies like Vital Stim.
  • Neurological Rehabilitation: Holistic programs for restoring function in individuals with disabling injuries or illnesses, addressing physical, social, emotional, and vocational aspects.
  • Sports Injury Management: Comprehensive care for sports enthusiasts, emphasizing injury prevention, mobility enhancement, pain relief, and overall physical well-being.
  • Cancer Wellness Program: Improving the quality of life after cancer through exercise programs, TNMES, myofascial release, and palliative treatments.
  • Stroke Rehabilitation: Specialized programs to help patients relearn lost skills, adapt to residual disabilities, and facilitate a return to community living.

Why Choose ILS Hospitals?

  • Patient-Centered Care: Putting patient needs first, our department offers closely coordinated, personalized care through a team of rehabilitation specialists.
  • Comprehensive Treatment: Understanding that each patient is unique, we deliver individualized care that considers specific needs, abilities, and objectives for optimal recovery.
  • Physiotherapy as Partnership: Recognizing patients as active participants in their recovery, we collaborate with them and their families to set and follow tailored treatment plans.
  • Low Patient-to-Therapist Ratio: Benefit from one-on-one sessions with therapists, ensuring focused attention and effective rehabilitation.
  • State-of-the-Art Resources: Access cutting-edge medical equipment and resources to support your journey to recovery.
  • Patient Education: We prioritize patient education, ensuring a deeper understanding of medical conditions and rehabilitative care for a more informed and engaged recovery.

Electro Therapy Session

  • IFT
  • UST
  • CPM
  • MST
  • Hydrocollator
  • Paraffin Wax Bath
  • Cervical and Lumbar Traction
  • SWD
  • TENS
  • IRR

Exercise Session

  • Neurological Rehabilitation
  • Cardiac Rehabilitation
  • Orthopedic and Sports Rehabilitation
  • Paediatric Rehabilitation
  • Obstetrics and Gynecology Rehabilitation
  • Geriatric Rehabilitation

Advance Treatment

  • Tapping
  • Dry Needling
  • Cupping Therapy
  • Joint Adjustment
  • MFR

In essence, ILS Hospitals is dedicated to providing compassionate and personalized physiotherapy and rehabilitation services, striving to make a positive impact on the lives of our patients.

name: Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery
heading: Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery
content:
Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery

Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery is a specialized medical field dedicated to restoring, reshaping, and enhancing the appearance and function of the body. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery offers a comprehensive range of services that address both cosmetic desires and medical needs, blending surgical precision with artistic skill to deliver exceptional outcomes.

Scope of Services

The department caters to a variety of patient needs, from aesthetic enhancements to complex reconstructive procedures. Cosmetic surgery services include facelifts, rhinoplasty, liposuction, abdominoplasty, and breast surgeries (augmentation, reduction, and reconstruction). Reconstructive procedures focus on restoring form and function after trauma, burns, cancer surgery, congenital deformities, or other medical conditions. This includes scar revisions, skin grafting, flap surgeries, hand surgery, and microsurgical reconstructions.

Expert Surgical Team

The Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery department at ILS Hospitals is led by highly skilled surgeons with expertise in both cosmetic and reconstructive techniques. Each surgeon is trained to combine scientific accuracy with aesthetic judgment, ensuring results that are natural-looking and tailored to the patient’s needs. The team also includes anesthesiologists, nursing staff, and rehabilitation specialists who work together to provide safe and holistic care.

Advanced Technology and Techniques

ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art operating theatres, advanced surgical instruments, and modern imaging facilities. Surgeons employ minimally invasive approaches wherever possible, resulting in smaller incisions, reduced scarring, and faster recovery times. Microsurgery capabilities allow the team to perform delicate procedures such as nerve repair and free tissue transfer with remarkable precision.

Burns and Trauma Reconstruction

Burn injuries and traumatic wounds can have a profound impact on both appearance and function. The department specializes in acute burn management, scar modulation, and long-term reconstructive procedures to restore mobility and aesthetics. For trauma patients, reconstructive surgery helps repair soft tissue damage, improve physical function, and restore self-confidence.

Cancer Reconstruction

Patients undergoing surgery for cancers, such as breast cancer or head and neck cancers, often require reconstructive procedures to restore their appearance and improve quality of life. The surgeons at ILS Hospitals work closely with oncologists to plan reconstructions that align with cancer treatments, ensuring both safety and aesthetic satisfaction.

Congenital Defect Corrections

The department also addresses congenital anomalies like cleft lip, cleft palate, ear deformities, and hand malformations. Corrective surgeries not only enhance appearance but also improve speech, feeding, and functional abilities in children, supporting healthy development.

Patient-Centric Approach

At ILS Hospitals, patient care goes beyond the operation theatre. Surgeons take time to understand each patient’s concerns, goals, and expectations. Detailed pre-operative counseling and post-operative follow-up ensure patients are well-informed, comfortable, and supported throughout their journey. Pain management, physiotherapy, and scar care are integrated into the recovery plan to ensure optimal outcomes.

The Department of Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery at ILS Hospitals stands as a blend of medical science, artistry, and compassionate care. Whether restoring form after injury, correcting congenital conditions, or enhancing natural beauty, the team delivers personalized solutions using advanced technology and refined surgical skills. With a commitment to safety, precision, and patient satisfaction, ILS Hospitals ensures that every patient receives results that enhance both function and confidence.

name: Psychiatry
heading: ILS Hospitals: Nurturing Mental Well-being through Psychiatry
content:
ILS Hospitals: Nurturing Mental Well-being through Psychiatry

Psychiatry, a specialized field of medicine, is dedicated to the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of behavioural, mental, and emotional disorders. At ILS Hospitals, our team of psychiatrists, equipped with medical expertise, plays a crucial role in addressing mental health concerns and substance abuse disorders.

Understanding Psychiatry:

Psychiatrists, as medical doctors, possess the unique ability to assess both the mental and physical aspects of psychological issues. They are adept at delving into the complexities of mental health disorders, making them instrumental in the holistic care of individuals facing these challenges.

Psychiatrist vs. Psychologist:

While psychiatrists and psychologists both contribute to mental health care, they differ in their educational backgrounds and approaches. Psychiatrists, with an MBBS and MD qualification, are medical doctors capable of prescribing medications. On the other hand, psychologists, often with a non-medical background and a focus on psychology, provide counselling and therapy. When deep-rooted medical conditions are involved, consulting a psychiatrist is imperative.

Conditions Treated by Psychiatrists:

Our psychiatrists are skilled in diagnosing, treating, and managing a spectrum of mental illnesses and issues, including but not limited to:

  • Schizophrenia
  • Bipolar disorder
  • Addiction (e.g., gambling, drugs, alcohol)
  • Depression
  • Suicidal thoughts
  • Eating disorders
  • Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)
  • Neurodevelopmental disorders (e.g., autism spectrum disorder)
  • Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
  • Sleep disorders
  • Memory problems

When to Consult a Psychiatrist:

Individuals should consider consulting a psychiatrist when experiencing:

  • Inability to Control Emotions: Consistent feelings of sadness, frustration, or hopelessness may indicate the need for psychiatric assistance to manage these emotions effectively.
  • Altered Sleeping Patterns: Disturbed sleep patterns, including difficulty falling or staying asleep, can significantly impact mental health. A psychiatrist can address such issues.
  • Substance Use: Problems related to substance use, whether alcohol, drugs, or other behaviours, warrant psychiatric intervention to reduce and eliminate such abuse.
  • Performance Issues at School or Work: Struggling academically or facing challenges at work may require psychiatric evaluation, especially in children and adolescents.
  • Withdrawal from Social Situations: A withdrawal from social interactions may be indicative of underlying mental health disorders, and seeking help from a psychiatrist is crucial.
  • Unexplained Physical Illnesses: Psychiatrists can diagnose unexplained and frequent physical ailments with no apparent cause.
  • Excessive Anxiety: Feelings of anxiety, stress, or persistent worries can be effectively managed with the assistance of a psychiatrist.
  • Suicidal or Self-Harming Thoughts: Immediate consultation with a psychiatrist is essential if an individual is experiencing suicidal thoughts or engaging in self-harming behaviour.
  • Violent or Agitated Behaviour: Violent or agitated behaviour may stem from underlying mental health issues, necessitating psychiatric intervention.

Following a comprehensive diagnosis, our psychiatrists devise a tailored treatment plan, which may include:

  • Medications

name: Psychology
heading: ILS Hospitals: Expert Clinical Psychology Services for Mental Health Well-being
content:
ILS Hospitals: Expert Clinical Psychology Services for Mental Health Well-being

Clinical Psychology is a specialized field within psychology that focuses on the assessment and treatment of mental health disorders and various psychological concerns. At ILS Hospitals, our team of seasoned clinical psychologists is dedicated to offering evidence-based interventions to help you overcome emotional and behavioural difficulties.

Areas of Expertise:

Our clinical psychologists are trained to assess, diagnose, and treat a spectrum of mental health conditions, including but not limited to:

  • Anxiety Disorders: Generalized anxiety disorder, panic disorder, social anxiety disorder.
  • Mood Disorders: Major depressive disorder and bipolar disorder.
  • Personality Disorders: Borderline personality disorder and narcissistic personality disorder.
  • Eating Disorders: Anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, and binge-eating disorder.
  • Substance Use Disorders: Alcohol use disorder and drug use disorder.
  • Trauma and Stressor-related Disorders: Post-traumatic stress disorder and acute stress disorder.
  • Obsessive-Compulsive and Related Disorders: Obsessive-compulsive disorder and body dysmorphic disorder.
  • Sleep Disorders: Insomnia, hypersomnia.
  • Psychotic Disorders: Schizophrenia and delusional disorder.
  • Neurodevelopmental Disorders: Autism spectrum disorder and attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder.

Our clinical psychologists often collaborate with psychiatrists to provide comprehensive treatment tailored to individual mental health needs. They offer a range of evidence-based treatments and interventions to address various mental health concerns.

Common Treatments Offered:

  • Cognitive-Behavioural Therapy (CBT): Identifying and changing negative thinking and behaviour patterns.
  • Psychodynamic Therapy: Exploring unconscious thoughts and emotions for gaining insight.
  • Mindfulness-Based Interventions: Developing awareness and acceptance to reduce stress.
  • Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT): Learning to manage difficult thoughts and emotions while pursuing goals.
  • Relational/Marital Therapy: Enhancing communication and relationships.
  • Family Therapy: Addressing family issues contributing to mental health concerns.
  • Group Therapy: Collaborative therapy for individuals with similar mental health concerns.

Clinical psychologists may recommend psychiatric consultation for medication management and also provide psychoeducation, coping skills training, and support.

Child Psychology Services:

Recognizing the critical phase of childhood development, we offer specialized child psychology services. Our compassionate team assesses and treats a range of mental health conditions in children and adolescents. Every child deserves the opportunity to thrive, and we are committed to providing the highest quality child psychology services. If you’re concerned about your child’s mental health, our team is here to support and guide you for a brighter future. Let’s work together to help your child reach their full potential—schedule an appointment with ILS Hospitals today.

name: Pulmonology & Chest Medicine
heading: Pulmonology Excellence at ILS Hospitals: Comprehensive Care for Respiratory Health
content:
Pulmonology Excellence at ILS Hospitals: Comprehensive Care for Respiratory Health

Pulmonology, a specialized branch of medicine, focuses on preventing, diagnosing, and treating various lung conditions and respiratory tract disorders. At ILS Hospitals, our dedicated pulmonologists are well-equipped to manage a spectrum of respiratory issues, ranging from common conditions like asthma to severe infections and lung cancers.

Multidisciplinary Care for Respiratory Wellness:

We take pride in providing multidisciplinary care to our patients, addressing conditions such as lung cancer, Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), sleep disorders, and Cystic Fibrosis. Our state-of-the-art pulmonary function laboratory ensures accurate diagnostics and aids in formulating precise treatment plans.

Comprehensive Services at ILS Hospitals Pulmonology Department:

Our team of experts extends beyond diagnostics and treatment, offering ancillary services that encompass respiratory care and nutritional support within a comprehensive healthcare setup.

Common Pulmonary Diseases Managed at ILS Hospitals:

  • Asthma:A chronic lung disorder characterized by inflamed and narrowed airways, resulting in symptoms like wheezing, coughing, shortness of breath, and chest tightness.
  • Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD):Encompasses chronic bronchitis and emphysema, leading to airflow blockage, with symptoms such as wheezing, chronic cough, bluish fingernails, unexplained weight loss, and shortness of breath.
  • Tuberculosis:A contagious respiratory disease with symptoms including chest pain, fatigue, fever, chronic cough, shortness of breath, and night sweats.
  • Cystic Fibrosis:A genetically inherited disorder affecting mucus, digestive juice, and sweat production, presenting symptoms like repeated lung infections, persistent cough with thick mucus, and wheezing.
  • Lung Cancer:A severe condition marked by the overproduction of abnormal cells in the lung, leading to the formation of malignant tumours. Symptoms include cough, chest pain, weight loss, and wheezing.

Importance of Timely Diagnosis:

Given the overlapping symptoms of various pulmonary diseases, it is crucial for individuals experiencing any respiratory distress to seek an accurate diagnosis from a reputable pulmonology hospital. Timely diagnosis enables healthcare professionals to recommend suitable treatment options tailored to the specific condition.

Effective Treatments Offered at ILS Hospitals:

  • Lifestyle Changes:For conditions like asthma and COPD, our expert pulmonologists suggest lifestyle modifications such as smoking cessation, adopting a healthy diet, avoiding extreme temperatures, and incorporating breathing exercises.
  • Medications:Prescribing medications tailored to manage symptoms and halt disease progression. Quick-relief drugs are recommended for asthma attacks.
  • Pulmonary Rehabilitation:A structured program designed to help patients manage symptoms and enhance their quality of life through targeted exercises and educational sessions.

Choose ILS Hospitals for Pulmonary Excellence:

Our commitment to delivering advanced pulmonary care, accurate diagnostics, and personalized treatment plans makes ILS Hospitals a trusted destination for respiratory health. With a focus on comprehensive well-being, we strive to enhance the lives of individuals grappling with pulmonary conditions. Trust ILS Hospitals for excellence in pulmonology, supporting you on your journey to respiratory wellness.

mainEntity.name: What are the visiting hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visiting hours are as followed: Ward/Twin Sharing/Cabin/Suite: 9am - 10am | 5pm - 7pm ITU/ICU/CCU/NICU/HDU: 5pm - 6pm | 9am - 10am (Saltlake only)

mainEntity.name: Rules and guidelines for visitors

acceptedAnswer.text: Visitors must carry visitor pass. Only two persons are allowed during visiting hours at Ward/Twin Sharing/Cabin/Suite and only one person is allowed during visiting hours at ITU/ICU/CCU/NICU/HDU. Children are strictly not allowed in critical care areas.

mainEntity.name: Is outside food allowed into the hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outside medicines and foods are not allowed within hospital premises. Patient meals are served as per instruction of the doctor and dietician.

mainEntity.name: What is the mode of payment in your hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: The payment can be made by Cash / Credit Card / Debit Cards/ DD/ Wire Transfer / Cheque.

mainEntity.name: Is advance payment must for an emergency case?

acceptedAnswer.text: During emergency every minute is vital so the admission is done immediately without any advance deposit money and the patient is taken under medical observation.

mainEntity.name: Do you have any health check up packages?

acceptedAnswer.text: ILS Hospitals are equipped with the latest and accurate testing equipments, trained technicians and specialists providing an advance range of health check up and screening services. This Health Check up Packages covers a wide range of investigations like from basic standard set of blood tests to detailed physical examinations and consultation by experienced doctors and each package is tailored to suit the needs of an individual.

mainEntity.name: Do you have the facility of cashless treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Cashless facility is available for empanelled TPA's & insurance Companies.

mainEntity.name: Is Mediclaim policy accepted at your hospital?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, empanelled TPA's & insurance Companies are accepted at the hospitals.

mainEntity.name: Does the hospital have 24×7 emergency care services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, 24 x 7 Emergency care service is available at the hospitals.

mainEntity.name: Is Dialysis facility available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Dialysis facility is available at ILS Hospitals Agartala and ILS Hospitals Dumdum.

mainEntity.name: How the bed charges are calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bed charges are calculated as per 24 hour basis from the time of admission.

mainEntity.name: Working hours of Admission and Billing section?

acceptedAnswer.text: Admission and Billing section functions 24x7.

mainEntity.name: What are the required documents for admission?

acceptedAnswer.text: The mainly required documents are Prescription of any previous treatment, Diagnostic test reports, Details of all medicine & dosages of the patient, Patient id proof, insurance or medical benefit card or proof.

name: Rheumatology
heading: ILS Hospitals: Pioneering Rheumatology Care for Joint Health
content:
ILS Hospitals: Pioneering Rheumatology Care for Joint Health

Rheumatic diseases encompass a spectrum of conditions affecting joints, muscles, bones, and connective tissues, demanding specialized care and a comprehensive approach. At ILS Hospitals, we are at the forefront of providing exceptional rheumatology care, dedicated to offering comprehensive solutions for individuals dealing with these complex conditions. Our team of highly skilled rheumatologists, advanced diagnostic capabilities, and cutting-edge treatment options position us as a leading institution in the field.

Unparalleled Expertise:

Our pride lies in the expertise of our experienced and board-certified rheumatologists at ILS Hospitals. They possess a profound understanding of intricate conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, osteoarthritis, gout, ankylosing spondylitis, and more. Combining clinical proficiency with compassion, our rheumatologists craft personalized treatment plans tailored to the unique needs of each patient.

Cutting-Edge Diagnostics:

Accurate and timely diagnosis is pivotal in rheumatology care, and ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art diagnostic facilities to meet this imperative. Advanced imaging technologies, including magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), ultrasound, and X-ray, enable meticulous evaluation of joint and musculoskeletal structures. Our laboratory services offer comprehensive blood tests, encompassing autoantibody profiles, inflammatory markers, and genetic studies, facilitating precise diagnosis and ongoing disease monitoring.

Holistic Treatment Approaches:

At ILS Hospitals, our rheumatology team collaborates seamlessly with other specialists, including physiotherapists, occupational therapists, and orthopaedic surgeons, to provide holistic care.

Common Rheumatic Diseases Treated:

  • Rheumatoid Arthritis: An autoimmune disease impacting joints, causing pain, swelling, and stiffness.
  • Osteoarthritis: A degenerative joint disease leading to cartilage breakdown, resulting in pain, stiffness, and reduced mobility.
  • Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE): An autoimmune disease affecting joints, skin, kidneys, heart, and lungs.
  • Psoriatic Arthritis: Affecting some with psoriasis, causing joint pain, stiffness, and inflammation.
  • Ankylosing Spondylitis: A chronic inflammatory arthritis primarily affecting the spine and sacroiliac joints.
  • Gout: Caused by uric acid crystal accumulation, resulting in sudden and severe joint pain.
  • Sjögren’s Syndrome: An autoimmune disorder characterized by dry eyes, dry mouth, joint pain, and fatigue.
  • Vasculitis: Inflammation of blood vessels affecting various organs.
  • Polymyalgia Rheumatica: An inflammatory disorder causing muscle pain and stiffness.
  • Scleroderma: Rare autoimmune diseases causing skin and connective tissue thickening.
  • Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (JIA): Arthritis occurring in children under 16.

Comprehensive Treatment Modalities:

  • Medications: Utilizing advanced medications, including DMARDs, biologic agents, corticosteroids, and NSAIDs, to manage symptoms and control inflammation.
  • Physical and Occupational Therapy: Tailored exercise programs to improve joint flexibility, strength, and mobility, enhancing daily activities.
  • Conservative Procedures: Joint injections, nerve blocks, and viscosupplementation to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation.
  • Surgical Interventions: Collaboration with orthopaedic surgeons for advanced facilities in joint replacements, arthroscopic procedures, and corrective surgeries.

At ILS Hospitals, we are committed to advancing rheumatology care, offering not just treatment but a pathway to improved joint health and overall well-being.

Common Rheumatic Diseases Treated: Rheumatoid Arthritis: An autoimmune disease impacting joints, causing pain, swelling, and stiffness. Osteoarthritis: A degenerative joint disease leading to cartilage breakdown, resulting in pain, stiffness, and reduced mobility. Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE): An autoimmune disease affecting joints, skin, kidneys, heart, and lungs. Psoriatic Arthritis: Affecting some with psoriasis, causing joint pain, stiffness, and inflammation. Ankylosing Spondylitis: A chronic inflammatory arthritis primarily affecting the spine and sacroiliac joints. Gout: Caused by uric acid crystal accumulation, resulting in sudden and severe joint pain. Sjögren’s Syndrome: An autoimmune disorder characterized by dry eyes, dry mouth, joint pain, and fatigue. Vasculitis: Inflammation of blood vessels affecting various organs. Polymyalgia Rheumatica: An inflammatory disorder causing muscle pain and stiffness. Scleroderma: Rare autoimmune diseases causing skin and connective tissue thickening. Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (JIA): Arthritis occurring in children under 16. Comprehensive Treatment Modalities: Medications: Utilizing advanced medications, including DMARDs, biologic agents, corticosteroids, and NSAIDs, to manage symptoms and control inflammation. Physical and Occupational Therapy: Tailored exercise programs to improve joint flexibility, strength, and mobility, enhancing daily activities. Conservative Procedures: Joint injections, nerve blocks, and viscosupplementation to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. Surgical Interventions: Collaboration with orthopaedic surgeons for advanced facilities in joint replacements, arthroscopic procedures, and corrective surgeries. At ILS Hospitals, we are committed to advancing rheumatology care, offering not just treatment but a pathway to improved joint health and overall well-being.

name: Speech Therapy
heading: ILS Hospitals: Advancing Speech Therapy for Enhanced Communication
content:
ILS Hospitals: Advancing Speech Therapy for Enhanced Communication

At ILS Hospitals, our Speech Therapy department is dedicated to assessing, diagnosing, and treating individuals of all ages facing challenges with speech, language, and swallowing. Our registered and highly skilled speech therapists, also known as speech-language pathologists, are committed to rectifying various speech and communication disorders.

Expertise of Our Speech Therapists:

Our panel of speech therapists encompasses specialists with proven excellence and experience in various domains, including:

  • Stroke Rehabilitation: Addressing speech difficulties arising from stroke-related issues.
  • Neuro-Rehabilitation: Specialized interventions for neurological disorders like Parkinson’s disease.
  • Swallowing Difficulties: Providing effective therapies for individuals facing challenges in swallowing.

Comprehensive Services and Facilities:

Speech-Related Problems Addressed:

  • Stammering/Stuttering
  • Childhood Apraxia of Speech (CAS)
  • Delayed Speech
  • Speech Misarticulation
  • Cleft Lip and Palate, Submucous Cleft
  • Aphasia
  • Dysarthria
  • Hoarse Voice due to Vocal Nodules, Vocal Paresis
  • Vocal Fold Paralysis

Our Services Include:

  • Speech Assessment: Thorough evaluation to understand individual needs.
  • Diagnosis: Identifying specific speech and language disorders
  • Treatment and Advice: Implementing personalized intervention plans.
  • Home Plan and Parent Counseling: Empowering families to contribute to the therapeutic process.

A comprehensive assessment is conducted for each patient, leading to the development of customized treatment plans employing the latest methodologies. Our highly trained specialists offer a wide variety of services in speech/language intervention.

Common Conditions Treated

  • Articulation Disorders: Difficulty in producing specific speech sounds, affecting clarity.
  • Fluency Disorders: Impaired rhythm, rate, and fluency, leading to repetition and avoidance of speech.
  • Resonance Disorders: Challenges in nasal airflow, impacting speech resonance.
  • Receptive Disorders: Difficulty comprehending others’ speech, affecting language processing.
  • Expressive Disorders: Challenges in expressing thoughts verbally, known as Pragmatic Skill Disorder.
  • Cognitive Communication Disorders: Impaired thinking ability due to brain injury affecting communication.
  • Learning Difficulty and Processing Problems: Seen in children with difficulty following instructions, short attention spans, and delayed speech and social skills.

Our commitment at ILS Hospitals is to enhance communication abilities and improve the overall quality of life for individuals facing speech-related challenges. If you or your loved ones are experiencing any such concerns, our dedicated team is here to support your journey towards effective communication. Contact us to schedule a consultation with our experienced speech therapists.

name: Sports & Rehabilitation Medicine
heading: Sport
content:
Sport

Sports injuries are not exclusive to athletes and can occur during various physical activities, both indoor and outdoor. Factors contributing to these injuries include accidents, inadequate protective gear, insufficient training, and the absence of proper warm-up routines.

Common symptoms of sports injuries include various types of pain (sharp, stabbing, cramping, burning, dull, achy, or throbbing), bruising, swelling, joint stiffness, limited range of motion, muscle spasms, difficulty using a limb, numbness, tingling, weakness, redness, and increased temperature at the site of injury.

Serious symptoms that warrant immediate medical attention include severe sports injuries like fractures and dislocations, deformity or lump on the injured joint, inability to move a joint, open wounds, severe pain or swelling, and unusual sounds during the injury.

Sports medicine physicians offer specialized medical care for sports- or exercise-related injuries, performance enhancement, overall fitness improvement, sports injury prevention, and maintaining a healthy and active lifestyle.

Common injuries treated by sports medicine physicians include shoulder injuries (torn rotator cuff), knee injuries (torn ACL, PCL, or meniscus), ankle injuries (sprains, strains, or instability), fractures, elbow injuries (golfer’s elbow, pitcher’s elbow, tennis elbow), and dislocated joints.

Orthopaedic surgeons or sports injury specialists are consulted when individuals experience sports-related injuries, seek performance improvement, undergo routine check-ups, or require guidance on using safety gear for specific joints. Orthopaedic surgeons may choose to specialize in specific branches known as subspecialties, such as hand and upper extremities, trauma surgery, foot and ankle (podiatry), pediatric orthopaedics, sports medicine, orthopaedic oncology, spine surgery, and joint replacement surgery.

ILS Hospitals: Transforming Lives Through Advanced Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Services

The Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Department at ILS Hospitals stands as a leading provider of tertiary-level rehabilitation services across North India, with prominent locations in Delhi NCR (Saket, Patparganj, Vaishali, Shalimar Bagh, Panchsheel Park, Greater Noida, Gurgaon, and Noida) and Dehradun. Designed to deliver top-notch patient care, this department plays a vital role in restoring independence to individuals after debilitating diseases or traumatic injuries. Our specialists collaborate with patients to minimize the physical and cognitive effects of disabilities, empowering them to achieve their maximum potential.

Benefits of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitative Care:

Depending on an individual’s medical and emotional condition, patients can experience various benefits from physiotherapy and rehabilitative care, including:

  • Return to Work: Restoration of functional abilities supports a smooth return to the workforce.
  • Independent Living Skills: Development of skills crucial for independent living, reducing the need for long-term home care.
  • Reduced Hospitalization: Shortened or less frequent hospital stays contribute to enhanced recovery.

Expertise:

The Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Department at ILS Hospitals boasts a team of highly skilled and experienced healthcare professionals. This includes physiotherapists, occupational therapists, orthopaedic therapists, sports therapists, paediatric therapists, cardiologists, neurologists, pulmonologists, rehabilitation assistants, and specialized nurses. Collaborating seamlessly, this team delivers world-class healthcare services, encompassing both inpatient and outpatient programs.

State-of-the-Art Infrastructure:

Equipped with modern infrastructure, our department utilizes advanced diagnostic and therapeutic technologies. Key components include:

  • Electrotherapy
  • Heat therapy/cryotherapy
  • Microwave diathermy
  • Hi-power laser
  • Short wave diathermy
  • Electromyography (EMG)/Biofeedback
  • Electrical Modalities (TENS, ultrasound, laser, EMS)
  • Balance board
  • Various therapeutic machines
  • Latest exercise equipment
  • Vital Stim for dysphagia management
  • Transcutaneous neuromuscular electrical stimulation (TNMES

Inpatient Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation:

Our state-of-the-art inpatient facility ensures optimal care for various conditions, including:

  • Cancer rehabilitation
  • Paediatric rehabilitation
  • Spine rehabilitation
  • Stroke rehabilitation
  • Traumatic brain injury
  • Pulmonary rehabilitation
  • Pain rehabilitation
  • Cardiovascular rehabilitation
  • Orthopaedic rehabilitation

Outpatient Services:

Our comprehensive outpatient services cater to a range of conditions, including:

  • Amputee rehabilitation
  • Arthritis rehabilitation
  • Dysphagia rehabilitation
  • Hand clinic
  • Lymphedema clinic
  • Osteoporosis rehabilitation
  • Paediatric rehabilitation
  • Spinal cord injury
  • Spine clinic
  • Sports injury rehabilitation
  • Stroke rehabilitation
  • Traumatic brain injury rehabilitation
  • Vestibular rehabilitation
  • Vascular/wound care centre
  • Back to work rehabilitation
  • Pulmonary rehabilitation
  • Fibromyalgia treatment centre
  • Manual therapy
  • Incontinence clinic

Holistic Approach:

Our Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Department serves as a one-stop destination for various physiotherapy and rehabilitative treatments. A thorough assessment by a physiotherapist or occupational therapist, considering health history, pain patterns, movement, strength, reflexes, sensation, and cardio-respiratory status, forms the basis for personalized treatment plans. The department offers services such as:

  • Cardiopulmonary Rehabilitation: A specialized program aiding patients with cardiac conditions in achieving optimal physical function.
  • Geriatric Care (Prevention of Falls): Tailored programs for seniors, focusing on regaining independence, enhancing safety, and reducing the risk of falls.
  • Dysphagia Management: Expertise in treating swallowing problems, especially post-stroke dysphagia, utilizing advanced therapies like Vital Stim.
  • Neurological Rehabilitation: Holistic programs for restoring function in individuals with disabling injuries or illnesses, addressing physical, social, emotional, and vocational aspects.
  • Sports Injury Management: Comprehensive care for sports enthusiasts, emphasizing injury prevention, mobility enhancement, pain relief, and overall physical well-being.
  • Cancer Wellness Program: Improving the quality of life after cancer through exercise programs, TNMES, myofascial release, and palliative treatments.
  • Stroke Rehabilitation: Specialized programs to help patients relearn lost skills, adapt to residual disabilities, and facilitate a return to community living.

Why Choose ILS Hospitals?

  • Patient-Centered Care: Putting patient needs first, our department offers closely coordinated, personalized care through a team of rehabilitation specialists.
  • Comprehensive Treatment: Understanding that each patient is unique, we deliver individualized care that considers specific needs, abilities, and objectives for optimal recovery.
  • Physiotherapy as Partnership: Recognizing patients as active participants in their recovery, we collaborate with them and their families to set and follow tailored treatment plans.
  • Low Patient-to-Therapist Ratio: Benefit from one-on-one sessions with therapists, ensuring focused attention and effective rehabilitation.
  • State-of-the-Art Resources: Access cutting-edge medical equipment and resources to support your journey to recovery.
  • Patient Education: We prioritize patient education, ensuring a deeper understanding of medical conditions and rehabilitative care for a more informed and engaged recovery.

In essence, ILS Hospitals is dedicated to providing compassionate and personalized physiotherapy and rehabilitation services, striving to make a positive impact on the lives of our patients.

name: Urology
heading: Advancing Urological Care at ILS Hospitals: Unmatched Expertise and State-of-the-Art Services
content:
Advancing Urological Care at ILS Hospitals: Unmatched Expertise and State-of-the-Art Services

At ILS Hospitals, we take pride in offering comprehensive and advanced treatment for a wide spectrum of urological conditions. Our cutting-edge facilities specialize in urology, uro-oncology, reconstructive urology, robotic surgery, kidney transplantation, laparoscopic andrology services, and more. We leverage the latest medical advancements to provide the highest clinical governance standards and patient-centric care.

Unparalleled Urological Services:

Laparoscopic Urological Surgery: Our team excels in laparoscopic urological surgery, ensuring precision and minimal invasiveness for improved patient outcomes.

Renal Transplantation: Our expertise in renal transplantation aims to provide life-changing solutions for individuals with kidney-related concerns.

Uro-Oncology: As a leading urology hospital, we address urological cancers through state-of-the-art oncological treatments.

Reconstructive Surgery of Urinary Tract: Our skilled surgeons perform reconstructive surgery to address urinary tract issues, enhancing patients’ quality of life.

Laser Urological Procedures: We utilize advanced laser technology for various urological procedures, ensuring precision and effectiveness.

Common Urological Conditions:

Urinary-Tract Infections (UTIs): Our specialists diagnose and treat UTIs, offering relief from symptoms like frequent urination and discomfort.

Kidney Stones: Addressing crystalized formations in the kidney, our experts provide effective solutions for kidney stone-related pain and discomfort.

Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH): For men dealing with prostate enlargement, our comprehensive approach tackles complications and improves urinary function.

Bladder Cancer: We specialize in diagnosing and treating bladder cancer, focusing on personalized and effective treatment plans.

Kidney Cancer: Our multidisciplinary team addresses kidney cancer with advanced treatments, emphasizing patient well-being.

Prostate Cancer: Offering specialized care for prostate cancer, our experts focus on early diagnosis and tailored treatment strategies.

Seeking Specialized Urological Care: If you’re experiencing symptoms related to urological conditions, prompt consultation with the best urology hospital in India is crucial. ILS Hospitals’ state-of-the-art facilities ensure accurate diagnostics, leading to effective and personalized treatment plans.

Urological Treatments:

Lifestyle Changes: In cases like UTIs, our experts recommend strategic lifestyle changes, including hydration and dietary adjustments, to manage symptoms.

Medications: Tailoring treatment to the specific urological condition, our physicians prescribe medications ranging from antibiotics to chemotherapy drugs.

Surgery: With a focus on patient-centric care, our surgical treatments, including laparoscopic procedures, robotic surgery, kidney transplantation, and reconstructive surgery, ensure optimal outcomes.

ILS Hospitals stands as a beacon of excellence in urological care, offering unmatched expertise and state-of-the-art services. If you or a loved one is facing urological concerns, trust our dedicated team to provide compassionate care and innovative solutions, ensuring a path towards improved urological health and overall well-being.

name: Anaesthesiology
heading: Anaesthesia at ILS Hospitals: Ensuring Comfort, Safety, and Pain-Free Surgical Experiences
content:
Anaesthesia at ILS Hospitals: Ensuring Comfort, Safety, and Pain-Free Surgical Experiences

Anaesthesia is a crucial component of the surgical process, designed to prevent pain and induce numbness at the surgical site. ILS Hospitals employs various methods to administer anaesthesia, tailored to the specific needs of each procedure. These methods encompass inhalation, topical applications, injections, skin patches, drops, and more.

Who Administers Anaesthesia?

Anaesthesiologists, specialists dedicated to administering anaesthesia and overseeing patient well-being during surgery, play a pivotal role in ensuring a smooth and pain-free surgical experience. While anaesthesiologists are the primary experts, other licensed medical professionals, such as dentists, nurses, surgeons, and general physicians, may also administer anaesthesia.

Types of Anaesthesia:

Local Anaesthesia:

  • Administered for small, localized procedures like cataract surgery or dental interventions.
  • Keeps the patient awake during the procedure, with the effect wearing off within 3-4 hour

Regional Anaesthesia:

  • Numbs a larger portion of the body, such as a limb or the area below the chest.
  • Patients may choose to stay awake or undergo sedation in addition to regional anaesthesia.
  • Examples include epidurals for childbirth and spinal anaesthesia for specific surgeries.

General Anaesthesia:

  • Induces absolute unconsciousness, rendering the patient insensitive to pain.
  • Employed for highly invasive procedures involving the brain, heart, or abdomen.

Sedation:

  • Induces a relaxed state or sleep, with easy arousal after the procedure.
  • Ranges from light to deep sedation, with deeper sedation administered by anaesthesia professionals.
  • Used in procedures like cardiac catheterization and colonoscopies.

Symptoms of Anaesthesia:

Anesthetized areas exhibit specific symptoms indicating the effectiveness of anaesthesia, including a sensation of heaviness, swelling, loss of pain sensation, and difficulty swallowing in oral or mouth anaesthesia.

When to Consult an Anaesthesiologist and Their Role:

Anaesthesiologists perform crucial roles throughout the surgical journey:

Pre-Surgery:

  • Conduct comprehensive medical history discussions.
  • Determine the type of anaesthesia suitable for the case.
  • Discuss associated risks and complications.
  • Obtain consent for the chosen aesthetic and pain control methods.

During Surgery:

  • Administer a single or combination of anaesthetics.
  • Monitor vital signs like blood pressure, pulse, blood oxygen levels, and heart rate.
  • Identify and manage any emergent issues during the procedure.
  • Provide post-surgical pain management.

Postoperative Care:

  • Address potential complications like anaesthesia awareness, collapsed lung, malignant hyperthermia, nerve damage, and postoperative delirium.
  • Assess patients for side effects and offer post-anaesthesia recovery support.

Recovering from Anaesthesia:

The duration of anaesthesia effects varies, with local anaesthesia wearing off in 3-4 hours and regional or general anaesthesia lasting over 24 hours. Patients are advised to refrain from driving or engaging in strenuous activities until the effects subside.

Why Anaesthesiologists are Essential:

Anaesthesiologists ensure patients undergo surgery safely and comfortably without experiencing pain. Their specialized techniques, including controlled blood pressure management, contribute to safer surgeries, reduced bleeding, and improved overall outcomes. Proper pain management post-surgery aids in physical therapy, enhances recovery, and minimizes postoperative complications.

At ILS Hospitals, our dedicated team of anaesthesiologists is committed to providing comprehensive care, ensuring a pain-free and secure surgical experience for every patient.

name: Paediatric Nephrology
heading: Paediatric Nephrology
content:
Paediatric Nephrology

Paediatric Nephrology is a highly specialized branch of medicine that focuses on the diagnosis, treatment, and management of kidney-related disorders in infants, children, and adolescents. At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Paediatric Nephrology is dedicated to providing comprehensive and compassionate care for young patients with kidney diseases, ensuring they receive the highest standard of treatment in a child-friendly environment.

Comprehensive Care for Kidney Disorders in Children

Children can suffer from a variety of kidney-related problems, ranging from congenital abnormalities and acute kidney injury to chronic kidney disease, urinary tract infections (UTIs), kidney stones, and nephrotic syndrome. The department also manages complex conditions such as glomerulonephritis, polycystic kidney disease, and hypertension related to kidney disorders. Early diagnosis and timely intervention are crucial to preserving kidney function and ensuring normal growth and development.

Expert Medical Team

The Paediatric Nephrology team at ILS Hospitals comprises highly qualified paediatric nephrologists, paediatricians, dialysis specialists, nurses, dietitians, and counsellors. These experts work closely with other specialists, such as paediatric urologists and cardiologists, to provide integrated care tailored to each child’s unique needs. With a deep understanding of the physiological differences in children, the team ensures that treatments are age-appropriate and safe.

Advanced Diagnostic and Treatment Facilities

ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art diagnostic tools for accurate evaluation of kidney function in children. Facilities include advanced ultrasound, Doppler imaging, renal scans, and laboratory services for specialized blood and urine tests. These tools help detect abnormalities early and guide targeted treatment plans.

Treatment options at ILS Hospitals range from medical therapy for infections and inflammation to interventional procedures for structural problems. The department also offers paediatric dialysis services, including peritoneal dialysis and haemodialysis, for children with severe kidney failure. For complex cases requiring surgical correction, the hospital’s paediatric surgery team works in close coordination with nephrologists.

Focus on Chronic Kidney Disease Management

Children with chronic kidney disease require long-term care, regular monitoring, and lifestyle adjustments. At ILS Hospitals, care plans include nutritional guidance, growth monitoring, blood pressure control, and counselling for both patients and families. In cases of end-stage renal disease, the team coordinates with transplant centers to ensure smooth referral and post-transplant follow-up.

Child-Friendly and Family-Centric Approach

Understanding that hospital visits can be stressful for children, ILS Hospitals provides a warm, supportive, and child-friendly environment. The medical staff ensures clear communication with both the child and their caregivers, explaining the diagnosis and treatment process in simple terms. Families are actively involved in decision-making, creating a sense of comfort and trust.

Preventive Care and Awareness

The department also emphasizes preventive measures, such as timely treatment of urinary tract infections, screening for congenital kidney anomalies, and education about hydration and healthy lifestyle practices. Awareness programs help parents recognize early warning signs of kidney problems in their children.

At ILS Hospitals, Paediatric Nephrology is not just about treating diseases—it is about nurturing health, growth, and well-being in young patients. With advanced technology, a skilled multidisciplinary team, and a compassionate, family-focused approach, the department ensures that every child with kidney-related issues receives expert care and the best chance for a healthy future.

At ILS Hospitals, the Department of Paediatric Nephrology is dedicated to providing comprehensive and compassionate care for young patients with kidney diseases, ensuring they receive the highest standard of treatment in a child-friendly environment. Comprehensive Care for Kidney Disorders in Children Children can suffer from a variety of kidney-related problems, ranging from congenital abnormalities and acute kidney injury to chronic kidney disease, urinary tract infections (UTIs), kidney stones, and nephrotic syndrome. The department also manages complex conditions such as glomerulonephritis, polycystic kidney disease, and hypertension related to kidney disorders. Early diagnosis and timely intervention are crucial to preserving kidney function and ensuring normal growth and development. Expert Medical Team The Paediatric Nephrology team at ILS Hospitals comprises highly qualified paediatric nephrologists, paediatricians, dialysis specialists, nurses, dietitians, and counsellors. These experts work closely with other specialists, such as paediatric urologists and cardiologists, to provide integrated care tailored to each child’s unique needs. With a deep understanding of the physiological differences in children, the team ensures that treatments are age-appropriate and safe. Advanced Diagnostic and Treatment Facilities ILS Hospitals is equipped with state-of-the-art diagnostic tools for accurate evaluation of kidney function in children. Facilities include advanced ultrasound, Doppler imaging, renal scans, and laboratory services for specialized blood and urine tests. These tools help detect abnormalities early and guide targeted treatment plans. Treatment options at ILS Hospitals range from medical therapy for infections and inflammation to interventional procedures for structural problems. The department also offers paediatric dialysis services, including peritoneal dialysis and haemodialysis, for children with severe kidney failure. For complex cases requiring surgical correction, the hospital’s paediatric surgery team works in close coordination with nephrologists. Focus on Chronic Kidney Disease Management Children with chronic kidney disease require long-term care, regular monitoring, and lifestyle adjustments. At ILS Hospitals, care plans include nutritional guidance, growth monitoring, blood pressure control, and counselling for both patients and families. In cases of end-stage renal disease, the team coordinates with transplant centers to ensure smooth referral and post-transplant follow-up. Child-Friendly and Family-Centric Approach Understanding that hospital visits can be stressful for children, ILS Hospitals provides a warm, supportive, and child-friendly environment. The medical staff ensures clear communication with both the child and their caregivers, explaining the diagnosis and treatment process in simple terms. Families are actively involved in decision-making, creating a sense of comfort and trust. Preventive Care and Awareness The department also emphasizes preventive measures, such as timely treatment of urinary tract infections, screening for congenital kidney anomalies, and education about hydration and healthy lifestyle practices. Awareness programs help parents recognize early warning signs of kidney problems in their children. At ILS Hospitals, Paediatric Nephrology is not just about treating diseases—it is about nurturing health, growth, and well-being in young patients. With advanced technology, a skilled multidisciplinary team, and a compassionate, family-focused approach, the department ensures that every child with kidney-related issues receives expert care and the best chance for a healthy future.

name: Vascular Surgery
content:
Vascular surgery is a specialized medical field dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of diseases affecting blood vessels, including arteries, veins, and lymphatic vessels. ILS Hospitals stands at the forefront of vascular care, offering a dedicated team of experienced vascular surgeons committed to enhancing patients’ circulatory health and overall well-being. Our approach encompasses both open surgical procedures and minimally invasive endovascular techniques, providing a comprehensive solution to a wide range of vascular disorders.

State-of-the-Art Facilities:

ILS Hospitals boasts state-of-the-art facilities, featuring advanced imaging technology and fully equipped operating rooms. These resources enable precise diagnoses and effective treatments, reflecting our commitment to innovation. By staying at the forefront of medical advancements, we deliver the most up-to-date and advanced vascular surgery procedures, ultimately improving patient outcomes and reducing recovery times.

Comprehensive Vascular Services:

Our Vascular Surgery department offers an extensive array of services tailored to address various vascular conditions, including but not limited to:

Peripheral Artery Disease (PAD) Treatment:

  • Angioplasty and stenting
  • Atherectomy
  • Endarterectomy
  • Bypass surgery
  • Endovascular procedures

Aortic Aneurysm Repair:

  • Open surgical repair
  • Endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR)

Carotid Artery Disease Treatment:

  • Carotid endarterectomy
  • Carotid artery stenting

Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) and Venous Disease Treatment:

  • Thrombectomy
  • Venous stenting
  • Sclerotherapy

Varicose Vein Treatment:

  • Endovenous laser treatment (EVLT)
  • Radiofrequency ablation (RFA)
  • Nonthermal Venaseal ablation

Dialysis Access Surgery:

  • Creation of arteriovenous (AV) fistulas
  • AV graft placement
  • Dialysis catheter insertion
  • Basilic vein transposition
  • Permacath/ Hickman Catheter Insertion

Patient-Centered Approach:

ILS Hospitals prioritizes patient-centered care, ensuring that each individual receives compassionate and personalized attention throughout their treatment journey. Our dedicated team is committed to addressing the unique needs of each patient, fostering trust, and creating a supportive environment.

Advanced Techniques and Minimally Invasive Procedures:

We emphasize the use of minimally invasive endovascular techniques whenever appropriate. These techniques offer benefits such as shorter hospital stays, quicker recovery times, reduced risk of complications, and improved cosmetic outcomes. Our skilled surgeons leverage the latest technology to achieve optimal results for our patients.

Continuum of Care:

At ILS Hospitals, our commitment extends beyond the surgical procedure. We provide comprehensive post-operative care, including rehabilitation and ongoing monitoring, ensuring optimal recovery and long-term vascular health. Patient education about preventive measures and lifestyle modifications is a key focus, aiming to minimize the risk of future vascular issues. Our holistic approach aims to empower patients and enhance their overall quality of life.
